title: Global Surety Underwriting Internship - Summer 2027
description:
Description

Are you interested in a career that combines finance, relationship management, and strategic business decision-making? Do you enjoy analyzing financial information, solving complex business challenges, and building strong professional relationships? If so, Liberty Mutual's Global Surety Underwriting Internship may be the perfect opportunity to launch your career.

The Details

As a Surety Underwriting Intern, you'll work alongside experienced underwriters to learn how surety bonds support economic growth, commercial development, and infrastructure projects. You'll gain hands-on experience in financial analysis, risk assessment, and relationship management while helping businesses secure the bonding capacity needed to pursue opportunities and fulfill contractual obligations.

Throughout this 11-week internship, you'll develop an understanding of how underwriters evaluate financial strength, assess business risk, and make informed decisions that help customers grow and succeed. In addition to hands-on work, you'll participate in a structured internship experience that combines formal training, mentorship, job shadow opportunities, and professional development. You'll also be introduced to the Associate in Fidelity and Surety Bonding (AFSB) curriculum, gaining foundational knowledge of surety underwriting and the surety bonding process.

This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location.

We encourage interested candidates to apply early, as recruiting begins in the fall and positions are filled on a rolling basis. Applications are reviewed, interviews are conducted, and offers are extended throughout the recruiting season as qualified candidates are identified.

Our Summer 2027 Early Talent internships are a set 11-weeks in length, with 2 options for start/end dates. Limited exceptions to these start/end dates may be considered on a case-by-case basis: May 17, 2027 - July 30, 2027 or June 1, 2027 - August 13, 2027

Qualifications

What you’ve got

  • You are pursuing a bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or comparable with at least one semester remaining following the Summer of 2027 with a minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA.
  • You have 0-2 years of professional experience.
  • You possess strong analytical, decision-making, and negotiating skills.
  • You have solid interpersonal skills and demonstrate a passion for customer service and fostering relationships.
  • You must be available to work full-time for 11 weeks
  • You must have permanent work authorization in the United States

A little about us

Liberty Mutual Surety, a business unit of Liberty Mutual Insurance, is the largest Surety in the United States and a leading global surety. Conducting business worldwide through fronting relationships and Liberty-owned subsidiaries, we provide bonds in over 60 countries for construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers, and commercial enterprises on an account and transactional basis. We are committed to building mutually profitable relationships by providing smart business solutions, ease of doing business, and consistent, responsive service. Liberty Mutual Surety is dedicated to the communities we serve and highly values a diverse workforce in more than 16 countries.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

title: Sr Staff Engineer - Engineer
description:
The Security Engineering team at Uber is focused on making the production and corporate environments secure by default to provide industry-leading solutions for Uber's production services and infrastructure. It provides our workforce and trusted partners a full stack identity and access management platform across a multi-cloud and hybrid SaaS environment. Our principal is secure by default with least privilege that enables business efficiency and productivity.

About the Team:

Core Security Engineering’s mission is to make the Uber production environment secure by default and provide industry leading products and services to all Uber's production services and infrastructure. We are focused on building both security primitives and end users products that help Uber engineers to secure their service, build trust, and advance security to enable our global business.

We are responsible for providing and managing systems, services, and libraries to provide access management, and enforcement at scale. The scope spans across multiple verticals like service-to-service authentication/authorization, employee to system auth, customer auth.

You’ll work on critical distributed multi-cloud services at a massive scale crafted with the best security practices at the forefront. You’ll be accountable for long term decisions on leveraging next generation infrastructure to continuously scale and operate such foundational security services.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Staff Engineer to join our cutting-edge technology team. In this role, you will be a thought leader, shaping the company’s cybersecurity architecture and engineering strategies to keep its security posture at the leading edge. The role involves defining the next-generation architecture spanning authorization platform and agent mesh identity — setting the technical direction that the rest of the org will build against. You will optimize multi-tenanted zero-trust identity security models within cloud-native architectures, and lead cross-functional initiatives. You will collaborate with global teams to establish robust security design patterns to ensure compliance with industry best practices, protecting sensitive data. You will be influential to shape Uber engineering security to adopt ‘shift-left’ principal, leading to an overall proactive cybersecurity practice.

---- What the Candidate Will Do ----

  1. Design and implement scalable zero-trust frameworks for applications, ensuring secure access and communication across microservices.
  2. Provide technical leadership, focusing on delivering impactful solutions to secure Uber and modernizing the company’s security stack, ensuring architecture stays current with evolving technologies and threats.
  3. Provide technical leadership in designing, implementing, testing, and rolling out the Authorization platform at Uber.
  4. Design and develop scalable, reliable, and high-performance platform and services for Uber’s cyber defense.
  5. Deliver high-quality code, conduct code reviews.
  6. Be intentional about leveraging AI/ML to shift-left security.
  7. Spearhead strategic cybersecurity projects. Conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate and implement emerging security solutions.
  8. Work closely with leadership to prioritize and manage engineering roadmaps.
  9. Partner with technology, business and compliance teams to ensure cybersecurity solutions support strategic objectives and regulatory requirements.
  10. Build, lead, and develop high-performing security engineering and architecture teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning and innovation.
  11. Act as a mentor and advocate for team members’ growth, focusing on upskilling talent to address evolving security challenges.

---- Basic Qualifications ----

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Expertise in writing high-quality code to solve strategically important problems that span multiple organizations, including proficiency in one or more programming languages (Go, Java, Python, C/C++) and code reviews.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, tools, and best practices
  • Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, system design, and architecture.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation
  • A growth mindset with the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
  • Experience leading org-wide engineering projects through all lifecycle stages: inception, stakeholder engagement, implementation, and operations.
  • Proven track record of overseeing incident management processes and directing on-call rotations in alignment with global best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound engineering/business tradeoffs, considering long-term implications for the greater good of Uber.

---- Preferred Qualifications ----

  • Experience building high-performance, scalable distributed systems at a 100M+ user scale.
  • Expertise in real-time streaming frameworks (Flink, Spark) and OLAP systems (Apache Pinot, Druid) to reduce system complexity.
  • Strong leadership traits: Experience serving as a representative for the organization to the broader internal and external technical community.
  • Proven ability to get alignment and buy-in for large-scale technology transformations across multiple job functions.
  • Experience with AI/ML technologies / frameworks and incorporating them into production systems

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year - USD $297,000 per year.

For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year - USD $297,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. title: Principal Software Engineer--M365 Work IQ
description:
Overview

Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first interfaces including REST APIs, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, CLI tooling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling developers to build intelligent, enterprise-aware agents and applications.

We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot Extensibility Engineering team, are looking for a Principal Software Engineer for Work IQ whose primary engineering focus is building the intelligence platform that connects AI agents to Microsoft 365 knowledge. You will own the design and development of Work IQ's REST and A2A APIs, MCP infrastructure, retrieval and orchestration services, and developer tooling. Your work will shape how agents access, reason over, and act on enterprise knowledge, helping establish Work IQ as the foundation for the next generation of Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent experiences.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of critical product and platform areas of the Work IQ API and related agentic components.

  • Set a high technical and quality bar for agentic systems and developer-facing tooling.

  • Design and ship performant, reliable terminal experiences that developers depend on for daily work.

  • Use data, benchmarks, and direct user feedback to guide iteration and investment.

  • Collaborate across org boundaries to enable other teams to build agentic products on top of a shared foundation.

  • Influence architecture, technical direction, and engineering standards beyond your immediate team.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating generative AI or agentic systems in production, with direct ownership over quality, reliability, and iteration.
  • Good experience building and shipping customer-facing developer interfaces/products, with depth across platform/foundation systems and user-facing experiences.
  • Solid product mindset with a track record of owning ambiguous problem spaces and driving them to high-quality outcomes.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals, including systems design, performance, and debugging in complex production environments.
  • Experience designing, running, and optimizing evaluations for agentic systems, including tools, prompts, and agent loops.
  • Experience building agentic development interfaces or working with related low level primitives is a strong plus.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Forward Development Engineer
description:
From the beginning, our goal was to establish an advisory firm that stands apart from the rest – one that is grounded in our Core Values and dedicated to creating a positive experience not just for our clients, but for our people too. We firmly believe in the strength of collaboration, enthusiasm, generosity, and perseverance as the driving forces behind our success. With advisory solutions spanning accounting and risk, technology-enabled transformation, and transactions, we partner with our clients to solve today’s challenges and deliver present and future value.

Our commitment to our people has earned us numerous awards including Inc5000's Fastest Growing Companies and Glassdoor's Best Places to Work. Explore what our employees have to say about our unique culture by clicking here.

By joining our rapidly growing AI Innovation & Transformation practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You’ll bring your first-hand engineering experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to design, deploy, and manage production-grade agentic AI solutions for the Office of the CFO and other enterprise functions. As a Forward Deployed Engineer & Agentic Workflow Engineer at CrossCountry Consulting you will be the tip of the spear for AI deployment at clients—embedding directly with client finance and operations teams to build, test, and iterate on agentic workflows that deliver measurable enterprise value on a compressed timeline. Operating at the intersection of software engineering, finance domain expertise, and client partnership, you will write production code alongside your clients, own the deployment of agentic solutions, and mentor junior engineers as a member of the practice team.

What You'll Do:

Client Delivery
Lead the development and delivery of services in the following areas:
  • Rapid Jumpstart deployment: Deploy AI Jumpstart packages within client environments, configuring data connectors, calibrating agent logic, and validating outputs against source system controls within the first week of engagement.
  • Agentic workflow design & build: Architect and implement multi-agent orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen; design task decomposition, inter-agent messaging, tool-call schemas, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) / human-on-the-loop (HOTL) checkpoints appropriate to the risk and materiality of each workflow step.
  • LLM integration & prompt engineering: Write, version, and optimize system prompts and structured output schemas for LLM-powered agents; implement function-calling / tool-use patterns against financial APIs; and fine-tune retrieval strategies (hybrid structured + RAG) to maximize accuracy and auditability.
  • Enterprise system integration: Build and certify MCP connectors and REST/GraphQL integrations to ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle), EPM (Adaptive Planning, Anaplan), CRM (Salesforce), and HRIS (Workday) systems, ensuring data freshness, completeness, and reconciliation to source-system controls.
  • Production deployment & reliability: Package agents as containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes or equivalent) and configure CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion (dev → staging → production), and monitoring/alerting so agents run reliably at client scale.
  • Client co-development: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with client finance, IT, and data teams; translate business requirements into technical agent design; facilitate working sessions; demonstrate working agents to executive stakeholders; and iterate rapidly based on feedback.
  • SOX & audit-readiness: Instrument agents with deterministic logging, source citations, and control documentation so every agent-generated output can be traced, validated, and presented to internal or external auditors.
  • Contribute to developing and implementing firm-approved, AI-enabled solutions for clients, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards.
  • Stay informed about emerging AI tools and techniques and collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes.
Practice Leadership
Serve as a key leader in the AI Innovation & Transformation practice by:
  • Developing reusable accelerators—contributing battle-tested code, workflow templates, and connector certifications back to the AI practice accelerator library to reduce deployment time on future engagements.
  • Creating new delivery methodologies and service offerings that scale agentic solutions across clients and enterprise functions.
  • Mentoring analysts and junior engineers on engagement teams, tracking and directing performance against objectives while encouraging continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Contributing to recruiting, proposal writing, and firm-wide AI innovation initiatives.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2 years focused on AI/LLM application development, agentic systems, or intelligent automation; prior “forward deployed” or client embedded engineering experience strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on production experience building multi-agent systems with LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks; understanding of agent-loop design, task planning, tool-use, and memory management.
  • Proficiency in Python (primary) and TypeScript/JavaScript; experience with FastAPI or equivalent for exposing agent capabilities as APIs.
  • Deep understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations: prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, context-window management, cost optimization, and latency tradeoffs across frontier models.
  • Experience integrating enterprise source systems via APIs and MCP connectors; familiarity with ERP, EPM, EDW/Data Lakes, and CRM data schemas in a finance context is a significant plus.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or equivalent) and RAG pipelines.
  • Finance domain fluency—ability to understand and implement workflows covering month-end close, variance analysis, revenue recognition, AR/AP, and FP&A without requiring extensive hand-holding from client finance teams.
  • Exceptional ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving client environments; a demonstrated track record of delivering working software in compressed, high-stakes timelines.
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; ability to present live-agent demonstrations to CFOs and finance leadership.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Openness to continuously learning and applying emerging LLM capabilities, agent frameworks, and enterprise integration patterns.

Qualifications:

description:

Here, you’ll get the opportunity to test your knowledge and skills and become a critical player within Westfall. We want you to view your time at Westfall as an investment to your future.

We are currently seeking Quality Inspector, with the below qualifications:

Job Overview

The Quality Inspector is responsible for inspecting materials, components, and finished
products to ensure they meet specified standards and customer requirements. This role
involves performing visual, dimensional, and functional inspections using measuring tools
and testing equipment. The Quality Inspector documents findings, identifies defects or
deviations, and works closely with production and quality teams to resolve issues. This
position plays a critical role in maintaining product quality, reducing rework, and supporting
compliance with internal and external quality standards.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform First Article, In-Process, and Final Inspections: Inspect products at initial, inprocess, and final stages to ensure they meet specifications, regulatory standards, and
customer requirements. Identify any deviations and implement corrective actions as needed.
• Monitor and Document Quality: Continuously monitor production to maintain quality and
complete inspection check sheets. Document results and discrepancies for future reference.
• Conduct CMM Testing: Use Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) to perform precise
dimensional testing. Address nonconformances promptly and ensure proper documentation
of all test results.
• Perform Dimensional and Functional Testing: Measure product dimensions and verify
functionality against specifications. Record data in the SPC database and take corrective
actions as needed.
• Report and Document Nonconformances: Report product defects and quality issues,
maintaining accurate records for traceability and collaborating with relevant teams to resolve
issues.
• Ensure Compliance with QMS and cGMP: Follow established Quality Management Systems
(QMS) and cGMP regulations to maintain product quality and ensure legal and industry
standards are met.
• Assist in Audits: Support internal and external audits, ensuring product, documentation, and
processes comply with both internal and regulatory standards.
• Perform Sorting and Rework: Assist in sorting defective products and perform rework to
ensure products meet quality standards before shipment.
• Assist in Training Inspector Packers: Train and observe Inspector Packers to ensure proper
inspection techniques and accuracy in their work.
• Ensure Safety Devices Are Intact: Regularly verify that machine safety devices are
functioning properly and report any malfunctions or tampering.
• Follow Safety Procedures: Adhere to safety protocols and ensure that all necessary personal
protective equipment (PPE) is used and in good condition.

Other Duties as Assigned
• Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the team and meet operational
priorities.

Specific Skill Set

Communication
Clearly reports defects and inspection results to
production and quality teams, collaborates effectively
with operators and supervisors on quality issues.

Presentation
Summarizes quality findings in team huddles or audits,
supports documentation for compliance and customer
reporting

System
Proficient in using quality inspection tools and digital
reporting systems, familiar with ERP and quality
management systems (QMS)

Analytics
Interprets inspection data to identify trends or recurring
defects, Assists in root cause analysis and continuous
improvement effort.

title: Reservations Specialist
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Reservations Specialist is responsible for managing the year-round registration and reservation process for Forest Home program guests. This position provides excellent customer service, maintains accurate reservation data, and supports church partners and ministry organizations throughout the event planning lifecycle.

The Specialist collaborates closely with Operations, Program Directors, and the Partnerships Team to ensure a high-quality guest experience and the successful execution of Forest Home’s mission.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Reservations Duties

  • Assist church partners and families with reservations by answering inquiries, providing availability information, and gathering required forms and documentation.
  • Maintain accurate reservation and guest information in the Reservations System (e.g., CircuiTree), CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot), and project tracking platforms (e.g., ClickUp).
  • Create and update itineraries, reports, communication logs, forms, and financial documents with accuracy and confidentiality in accordance with Forest Home policies.
  • Process required paperwork, including medical consent forms, voluntary disclosure forms, and campership applications.
  • Prepare weekly checklists to ensure event readiness and departmental alignment.
  • Review and reconcile reservation records prior to event execution.

Customer Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for church/group leaders, families and guests, providing timely, professional, and courteous communication.
  • Respond to all emails and calls by the next business day with accurate and helpful information.
  • Train and guide group leaders through the reservation process to ensure organizational and guest needs are met.
  • Maintain a gracious, service-oriented, and Christ-like attitude in all interactions.

Administrative Duties

  • Prepare guest check-in materials, including printed packets, nametags, keys, and wristbands.
  • Conduct on-site check-in for groups and individual registrants, including weekend events such as winter programs.
  • Follow up with group leaders and guests to ensure all balances are paid promptly.
  • Create church rosters, organize and maintain rooming lists for church partners and families, and coordinate key distribution.
  • Ensure compliance with Forest Home cash-handling and financial procedures when collecting and processing payments (checks, ACH, credit card transactions).
  • Depositing of all checks for Guest Retreats and Program Reservations.

Contracts & Financial Management

  • Oversee the distribution and management of Youth, Children & Family Camp scholarship funds to ensure eligible guests and groups receive appropriate financial support.
  • Send out and manage all group contracts to ensure timely execution and compliance with Forest Home policies.
  • Proactively follow up with group leaders, families and guests to ensure all remaining balances are paid promptly.
  • Follow Forest Home cash-handling and financial procedures when processing payments via checks, ACH, or credit card.

Communication & Coordination

  • Support the Senior Director of Guest Retreats & Reservations and sales coordinators in achieving annual program attendance goals and stewarding the guest experience.
  • Maintain active coordination with the Sales & Reservations to align on housing sheets, booking accuracy, and database management.
  • Partner with Program Directors and Managers to advocate for guest needs and ensure the successful execution of Forest Home’s mission during seasonal events.
  • Work closely with Accommodations and Operations to organize rooming lists, coordinate key distribution, and manage housing logistics for all groups.
  • Participate and coordinate pre-event planning meetings to ensure all departments are aligned on guest rosters and specific program requirements.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across departments to enhance efficiency and the overall guest lifecycle.

Supervisory & Leadership Responsibilities

  • Supervise seasonal staff members, including training, task assignment, and performance support.
  • Hire, onboard, and supervise up to two additional seasonal Reservations staff during winter and up to 5 additional seasonal Reservations staff during summer.
  • Support scheduling and workload allocation within the Reservations Department.

Program-Specific Responsibilities

  • Provide registration support for Family Camp, Youth and Children’s programs, and year-round conferences.
  • Send and coordinate pre-arrival emails for Family Camp and Youth and Children’s programs.
  • Manage check-in for all camp programs year-round.
  • Oversee registration and administrative support for the Radiant Discipleship Program.
  • Support sales efforts for Youth and Children’s ministry programs.
  • Coordinate rebooking for Youth and Children’s programs annually, including on-site rebooking for Family Camp.

Other Responsibilities

  • Maintain regular, timely attendance and a flexible schedule that may include weekends.
  • Participate in Staff Meetings and Forest Home spiritual life activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • 3+ years of experience in guest services, reservations, event coordination, or related field.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and commitment to hospitality.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Proficient in CRM, registration, or reservations software.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience in a camp, retreat center, or ministry environment.
  • Knowledge of group housing, event logistics, and guest communication best practices.
  • Experience working in nonprofit or faith-based settings.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Uphold and support Forest Home’s Mission, Vision, and Core Values.
  • Demonstrate a professional attitude through performance, appearance, and demeanor.
  • Ability to pray with guests and staff when appropriate and represent Forest Home’s Christian mission in interactions.
  • Active participation in staff spiritual life activities.
  • Flexible, dependable, and able to perform a variety of tasks.
  • Signed Statement of Faith.
  • Excellent customer service, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork skills and a servant-hearted, Christ-like approach.
  • Self-starter with the ability to streamline processes and complete high-quality work.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and perform administrative tasks.
  • May lift, push, or pull objects up to 20 pounds.
  • Requires visual acuity for reading and computer work, and sufficient speaking/hearing ability to communicate in person and by phone.

Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Primarily office-based with occasional outdoor exposure during guest check-in or events.
  • Noise levels vary from moderate to loud depending on campus activity.
  • May involve occasional work in varying weather conditions.

FOREST HOME EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties at any time. All terms and conditions of employment, duties, and responsibilities are subject to the Forest Home Employee Handbook. This job description may be modified as business needs evolve.

FOREST HOME CORE VALUES

Surrender to Christ (Romans 12:1-2)

  • Abide with the Lord daily through study of His Word and prayer
  • Surrender to the Lord daily through obedience to His Word
  • Worship the Lord with the Forest Home Community
  • Commit to grow in your faith through regular attendance at a local church
  • Prioritize God, Family, and Work appropriately
  • Be prepared to share your testimony with staff or guests
  • Walk in Biblical purity (1 Timothy 4:12) by rejecting one’s sinful nature

Love (I Corinthians 13)

  • Display the fruit of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control (Galatians 5:22)
  • Be respectful to others
  • Demonstrate compassion

Serve (Philippians 2:3-11)

  • Give generously to God and others through time, talent and treasure
  • Seek to put others’ needs above your own
  • Demonstrate humility in both spirit and deed
  • Actively look for ways to serve

Walk in Integrity (Titus 2:11-12, Proverbs 4:23-27)

  • Show loyalty to others, even when they are not present
  • Do the right thing, even when others are not present
  • Extend trust and seek to believe the best in others
  • Ask for forgiveness quickly when necessary
  • Be truthful and transparent with others

Strive for Excellence (Colossians 3:23-24)

  • Demonstrate accountability with time and resources
  • Request and receive training
  • Desire to improve, and challenge others to do the same
  • Commit to exceeding guest expectations
  • Refuse mediocrity

Engage in Community (I Thessalonians 5:11-13)

  • Seek first to understand before being understood
  • Communicate clearly, empathetically and respectfully
  • Work through conflict Biblically (Matthew 18-15-17)
  • Participate in intentional and purposeful community activities
  • Partner with teammates for the goal of unity and team effectiveness
  • Play and appreciate “campy” fun
  • Faithfully pray for one another

Innovate (Ephesians 3:20-21)

  • Dream Big
  • Proactively seek solutions
  • Think outside the box
  • Dream, plan and execute new ideas
  • Acknowledge and trust that all things are possible through Jesus Christ our Lord (Matthew 19:26)

title: Patient Navigator - Digestive Disease Center - 8hr Days
description:

title: Security Engineer, Applied AI
description:
Meta is seeking Security Engineers to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. As a Security Engineer in AAI, you will apply deep domain expertise to solve hard, real-world security problems — building novel security capabilities, prototyping AI-powered defenses, and advancing the frontier of what AI systems can do in security. Your work is AI-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.

You will blend hands-on security engineering with applied research — designing and executing novel approaches to security challenges that push both the state of Meta's security posture and the state of the art in AI-driven security. This includes building security products and tools, conducting original adversary research, developing detection and response capabilities, and translating security expertise into scalable, AI-native systems. Your domain knowledge — whether in detection engineering, threat intelligence, cloud security, adversary simulation, forensic investigation, or emerging areas — becomes the foundation for capabilities no existing AI system can replicate.

This role is for security practitioners who want to operate at the intersection of deep security expertise and frontier AI — not just using AI as a tool, but shaping what it is capable of.

title: Computer Engineer (RAS)
description:
At PMAT, we work on mission critical systems that directly support the warfighter, designing, building, and securing modern digital capabilities across cloud, data, and software environments. Our teams tackle complex, real-world challenges where delivery matters more than theory, and innovation is driven by curiosity, collaboration, and purpose.

In this role, you’ll contribute to Naval Operational Architecture (NOA), working alongside engineers and operators to deliver resilient, forward-leaning solutions in support of national defense.


About the role: PMAT is seeking a highly experienced Computer Engineer to provide senior-level technical leadership for the design, acquisition, integration, and deployment of hardware and computing solutions supporting global robotics and autonomous systems operations. This role will lead efforts to develop and field enterprise and edge computing infrastructure, including innovative solutions that are not currently available within existing fielded environments. The candidate will work closely with integration teams, emerging technology platforms, engineering organizations, and operational stakeholders to develop mission-ready solutions that address any constraints through small-form-factor computing, mobile servers, workstations, and related hardware technologies. The role requires strong computer engineering expertise, technical leadership, hardware lifecycle management, and the ability to deliver reliable computing solutions across Department of War locations worldwide.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, evaluation, acquisition, integration, and deployment of computing hardware and supporting software solutions for enterprise, edge, robotics, and autonomous systems environments.
  • Lead and coordinate teams of engineers responsible for acquiring, building, configuring, integrating, testing, installing, and sustaining hardware and software solutions at Department of War locations worldwide.
  • Develop innovative computing solutions for emerging operational requirements by evaluating small-form-factor computers, mobile servers, workstations, edge computing platforms, and other technologies to address physical and deployment constraints.
  • Support the design and redesign of IT and hardware architectures, including new system implementations, field changes, technology refreshes, upgrades, hardware replacements, and integration with existing infrastructure.
  • Manage engineering schedules, technical tasks, dependencies, hardware acquisition activities, and integration milestones to ensure systems are delivered in accordance with customer and operational requirements.
  • Manage robotics and autonomous systems equipment inventories by maintaining hardware accountability, configuration information, lifecycle status, deployment information, and planning inputs for replacement or modernization.
  • Develop and maintain detailed engineering documentation, including hardware designs, system configurations, bills of material, installation procedures, maintenance procedures, technical specifications, and configuration records.
  • Provide senior-level technical guidance to engineers, integration teams, program stakeholders, and operational personnel while troubleshooting complex hardware, software, infrastructure, and system integration challenges.
  • Plan and execute system installations, upgrades, technology refreshes, and new capability implementations while ensuring solutions meet applicable technical, cybersecurity, interoperability, and industry requirements.

About Us: PMAT is an innovative small business founded with a passion for developing forward-leaning solutions from exceptional people that increase the mission's capability. We focus on designing and building impactful digital solutions that utilize modern cloud, data, and software concepts. Our passion is working on complex and progressive challenges such as edge platform computing, containerizing legacy platforms, distributed data platforms, or heterogeneous data analysis.

We recruit, retain, and foster a team motivated to pursue passions, investigate new ways of doing things, and embody an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in being curious about every element of a problem and experiment relentlessly. We foster continuous learning in an environment that encourages positive collaboration and expands our capabilities. We tap into collective intelligence, acknowledging that the most brilliant people may not be in the room. Above all else, we believe that delivering and demonstrating is more potent than a sheet of paper. We are passionate about mission-centric design and delivering effective capabilities to and for the warfighter.

Whether you’re an experienced engineer or just beginning your career, you’ll work alongside experts who are committed to solving mission-critical problems. If you’re passionate about using your skills to make a real difference, apply today and become part of a team that’s shaping the future of defense technology!


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Extensive experience in computer engineering, hardware engineering, systems integration, infrastructure engineering, or related technical disciplines supporting complex computing environments.
  • Experience designing, acquiring, building, integrating, testing, installing, and sustaining computer hardware and supporting software solutions.
  • Experience leading engineers or multidisciplinary technical teams responsible for hardware acquisition, system integration, installation, deployment, or sustainment activities.
  • Strong understanding of computing hardware architectures, servers, workstations, storage, networking components, peripherals, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Experience evaluating technical requirements and developing hardware solutions based on performance, interoperability, environmental, deployment, and operational constraints.
  • Experience supporting system design and redesign activities, hardware upgrades, technology refreshes, field changes, configuration management, and lifecycle planning.
  • Experience managing engineering schedules, technical tasks, dependencies, equipment requirements, and customer delivery milestones.
  • Experience developing and maintaining detailed technical documentation for hardware designs, configurations, installation, maintenance, and sustainment activities.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate on complex technical challenges across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide technical direction and communicate engineering recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and status to technical, program, and operational stakeholders.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting Navy, Department of War, government, or other mission-critical operational environments.
  • Operational experience supporting active-duty military customers and fielded capabilities at government or military installations.
  • Experience supporting robotics and/or autonomous systems, unmanned platforms, autonomous systems, or infrastructure enabling globally distributed robotic operations.
  • Experience designing computing solutions around physical constraints, including small-form-factor computers, mobile servers, ruggedized workstations, edge computing systems, and deployable infrastructure.
  • Experience integrating computing hardware with emerging technology platforms, sensors, networks, cloud infrastructure, tactical systems, or autonomous platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise and edge server technologies, embedded computing, GPUs, high-performance computing hardware, virtualization, containerized workloads, or other mission-focused compute architectures.
  • Experience performing hardware trade studies, component evaluations, technical assessments, compatibility analysis, or make/buy recommendations for emerging computing requirements.
  • Experience managing technical equipment inventories, hardware configurations, asset lifecycle information, technology refresh planning, and End-of-Life considerations.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity, system hardening, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, and accreditation considerations associated with deploying computing hardware in government environments.

title: Composite Technician (Multiple Levels)
description:
About Pyka

Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation.

To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems.

We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.

Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce CO2 emissions in their respective industries.

What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day.


Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Entry-Level Composite Assembly Technician to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you will work with advanced materials like fiberglass, carbon fiber, and epoxy resins to build high-performance components.

This is a full-time, entry-level position. While prior manufacturing experience is a plus, we provide comprehensive on-the-job training for candidates who possess strong mechanical aptitude, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to safety and quality.

Responsibilities

  • Secondary Processing: You will own the completion of composite components delivered by outside vendors. In this role, you will help establish the initial workflow, scale operations to meet a projected 24-month volume increase, and continuously optimize workstations to maximize efficiency and process flow.
  • Component Assembly: Bond, fasten, and assemble composite structures, sub-assemblies, and hardware using blueprints, engineering drawings, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Material Preparation: Kitting, cutting, and preparing composite materials (carbon fiber, fiberglass, core materials) according to specific ply patterns.
  • Lamination & Layup: Perform wet layup lamination processes, ensuring materials are applied to molds without voids or wrinkles.
  • Tooling & Preparation: Clean, prep, and apply release agents to molds and assembly fixtures before production.
  • Finishing Operations: Use hand and power tools (drills, sanders, grinders) to trim, sand, deburr, and finish cured composite parts to exact specifications.
  • Quality Assurance: Inspect finished parts for defects and document quality checks.
  • Safety & Maintenance: Maintain a clean, organized work area and strictly adhere to safety protocols, including wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as respirators and safety glasses.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent trade school certificate.
  • Strong hand-eye coordination and comfort working with basic hand and power tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic mechanical drawings, work instructions, and measurements (or a strong willingness to learn).
  • Ability to stand for extended periods, lift up to 50 lbs, and work with chemical resins, adhesives, and dust (with proper PPE).
  • Precision-oriented mindset necessary for working with tight tolerances and strict quality standards.
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to work collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent listening and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in assembly, manufacturing, automotive repair, carpentry, or construction.
  • Familiarity with epoxy, resins, gel coats, or body shop fillers.
  • Basic understanding of precision measuring instruments (calipers, tape measures).

Compensation and Benefits

  • Technician Level I: $29 - 32/hr + equity.
  • Technician Level II: $35 - 39/hr + equity.
  • Compensation will vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Hourly wage ranges are subject to change.
  • Employer-sponsored health, dental and vision insurance
  • FSA with employer matching
  • 401(k)
  • Paid holidays, generous PTO, and additional unpaid time off
  • Voluntary short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Free catered lunch and plenty of snacks

Export Control Requirements

This position requires access to technology, software and other information that is subject to governmental access control restrictions, due to export controls. Employment in this position is conditioned on the continued availability of government authorization to authorize release of such items, to the extent required, including without limitation an export license, or other documentation required to establish authorization to receive access to such items.

Company may delay commencement of employment, rescind an offer of employment, terminate employment, and/or may modify job responsibilities, compensation, benefits, and/or access to Company facilities and information systems, as Company deems appropriate, in order to ensure compliance with applicable government access control restrictions.

title: Systems Engineer (Spectrum SME)
description:
Expression is seeking a highly motivated Systems Engineer (Spectrum SME) to support electromagnetic spectrum engineering, analysis, and management for military and government spectrum-dependent systems. The role involves reviewing and evaluating technical parameters of proposed mobile service provider systems, performing RF engineering analyses, validating system data, and assessing electromagnetic spectrum compatibility with existing government systems to support coordination and prevent interference.. The position requires the ability to interpret complex technical information, evaluate system performance parameters, identify potential spectrum compatibility issues, and develop engineering solutions that support operational requirements. It also involves periodic process and analytical tool improvement. The ideal candidate will have a background in military RF electronics, spectrum analysis, and systems engineering, with a focus on evaluating technical parameters and supporting operational requirements. This work supports electromagnetic spectrum operations (EMSO) and engineering, improving spectrum coordination and deconfliction across the Department of Defense (DoD) and its inter-agency partners.

Security Clearance:

  • Secret with eligibility for Top Secret Clearance required

Location:

  • Onsite in Fort Meade, MD

Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate technical parameters and operational requirements of military and government spectrum-dependent systems.
  • Review and evaluate proposed commercial wireless network deployments and modifications to assess potential impacts on military and government spectrum-dependent systems.
  • Perform engineering analysis to assess RF system performance, spectrum compatibility, and potential interference.
  • Analyze potential interference scenarios involving commercial wireless systems and existing government systems operating within adjacent or overlapping frequency bands.
  • Develop technical validation criteria and analytical methodologies to support spectrum engineering.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to derive and validate system parameters from multiple sources.
  • Use engineering and data analysis tools to manage and analyze technical datasets.
  • Record, analyze, and maintain parametric data of military and government spectrum-dependent systems.
  • Generate reports and present findings to Government stakeholders.
  • Maintain configuration management of technical data and engineering documentation.
  • Coordinate with engineering and operations teams to improve the accuracy and availability of spectrum data.
  • Support equipment certifications, system allocations, assignments, and spectrum deconfliction.
  • Provide technical support by investigating and resolving spectrum compatibility and RF interference issues.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of spectrum engineering processes, tools, and analytical capabilities.
  • Perform user testing and validation of spectrum engineering software and tools.
  • Support the refinement of technical processes and analytical methodologies to improve the consistency, accuracy, and efficiency of MSP engineering assessments.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering, or related STEM fields. Degree requirements can be waived based upon military experience.
  • Technical Background: Experience with military electronics, RF systems, component-level troubleshooting, or electrical systems. Strong understanding of RF principles, antenna theory, propagation modeling, cellular communications, and wireless system characteristics. Ability to interpret electronic schematics, technical specifications, and engineering documentation, and perform basic RF calculations..
  • Spectrum Engineering & Analysis: Experience or demonstrated understanding of RF engineering, spectrum compatibility, interference analysis, and technical data validation. Ability to evaluate transmitter and receiver characteristics, frequency relationships, and operational parameters.
  • Software Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Sharepoint tools. Experience using engineering or analytical software to evaluate RF system characteristics, spectrum compatibility, and interference. Familiarity with spectrum management processes, technical data validation, and analysis of large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Technical experience (i.e., designing, manufacturing, repairing) with RF systems (e.g., Radios, Sensors, Jammers).
  • 5+ years of experience as a military electronics technician (or equivalent depending upon the Service). Ideally a depot-level component repair technician.
  • 5+ years of experience in Spectrum Analysis, RF engineering, or spectrum management.
  • Experience supporting DoD, federal government, or military spectrum engineering programs.
  • Familiarity with commercial cellular technologies, including LTE and 5G NR.
  • Experience evaluating RF interference, spectrum compatibility, and electromagnetic environmental effects.
  • Familiarity with mobile service provider coordination, commercial wireless infrastructure, or carrier network deployments.
  • Experience developing engineering assessments, technical reports, and mitigation recommendations.

Additional Information:

This role does not involve hands-on equipment repair. It focuses on systems engineering, spectrum analysis, technical research, and spectrum management support.The engineer will evaluate commercial wireless deployments and their potential effects on military and government systems, contributing to engineering recommendations that support spectrum coordination and mission assurance. Preference will be given to candidates with military electronics training and experience in RF systems, including depot-level repair; however, specific education and experience requirements may be waived based on demonstrated technical knowledge, relevant experience, and capabilities..

Benefits:

Expression offers competitive salaries and benefits, such as:

  • 401k matching
  • PPO and HDHP medical/dental/vision insurance
  • Education reimbursement up to $10,000/yr
  • Complimentary life insurance
  • Generous PTO and 11 days of holiday leave
  • Onsite gym facility and trainer

About Expression:

Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Washington DC, Expression provides data fusion, data analytics, AI/ML, software engineering, information technology, and electromagnetic spectrum management solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of State, and national security community. Expression’s culture focuses on creating immediate and sustainable value for our clients via agile delivery of tailored solutions built through constant engagement with our clients. Expression was ranked #1 on the Washington Technology 2018's Fast 50 list of fastest-growing small business Government contractors and a Top 20 Big Data Solutions Provider by CIO Review.

We make sure to provide everyone with the tools and opportunities to grow while working on some of the newest technologies in the industry. title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
At Wavelynx, we design and manufacture open-architecture physical access control hardware and software solutions. Our reader and controller technologies bridge the gap between traditional smart credentials, mobile credentials (Apple Wallet, Employee Badges), and secure cloud-managed networks. We empower physical security systems to be flexible, interoperable, and future-proof.



Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Firmware Engineer to develop and optimize current embedded products along with our next-generation of access control products. In this role, you will work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams to design resilient firmware handling NFC/RFID communications, secure element integrations, cryptographic protocols, and network communications (OSDP, Ethernet, IP-based access control).



Supervisory Responsibilities

None



Duties/Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement, and maintain bare-metal and RTOS-based firmware for smart card readers and controllers.
  • Optimize high-frequency (13.56 MHz) RFID/NFC field processing, ISO/IEC 14443, ISO/IEC 18092, and MIFARE/DESFire protocols.
  • Integrate and secure mobile credentials, including Apple Wallet and Google Wallet credentials, using Secure Elements (SE) and Secure Application Modules (SAM).
  • Implement secure physical and logical communication protocols between readers, controllers, and cloud environments (e.g., OSDP, TLS/TCP/IP, RS-485, BLE, Ethernet).
  • Develop robust firmware update mechanisms (OTA / FOTA) over network protocols while ensuring tamper resistance and zero downtime.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues across local serial buses, IP networks, and RF interfaces.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers during schematic review, board bring-up, signal integrity testing, and power management optimization.
  • Drive automated firmware testing, unit testing, and CI/CD pipelines for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for field escalation issues related to RF performance, timing dependencies, or protocol compliance.


Required Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development experience using C and C++.
  • Strong background with real-time operating systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar) and ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.
  • Experience with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.
  • Be willing to travel domestically and internationally ranging from 0 to 10 days per year.


Nice to Haves

  • Direct background in the Physical Access Control System (PACS) industry.
  • Hands-on experience with NFC chipsets (e.g., ST25R-series similar), ISO 14443 Type A/B, Felica, or ISO 15693 standards.
  • Proven expertise with industrial or secure communication protocols (OSDP, RS-485, TCP/IP, UDP, TLS/DTLS, MQTT, or BLE stack development).
  • Deep knowledge of symmetric/asymmetric encryption (AES, ECC, RSA), PKI, secure boot, and hardware root-of-trust implementations.
  • Experience with static code analysis and RF test equipment (e.g., Proxmark, network analyzers).
  • Exposure to compliance and certification standards (UL 294, FCC, CE, ISO/IEC standards).



Salary Benefits

Salary: $120-150k

Benefits include great rates on company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision with HSA-eligible plans available, generous retirement with up to 6% 401k match, and holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

title: Optical Scientist - DSR
description:
At Meta Reality Labs, we build world-class consumer virtual, augmented, and mixed reality experiences. You'll work alongside leading scientists and engineers on the technology that will make AR and VR pervasive — turning science fiction into products people use every day.

The Advanced Photonics group within Display Systems Research (DSR) is hiring an Optical Scientist to push nano-photonics research toward wearable AR systems that enable advanced perceptual capabilities. title: Supervisor, Financial Operations/Superviseur(e), Opérations financières/ ᑲᒪᔨ, ᑮᓇᐅᔭᓕᕆᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐊᐅᓚᑕᐅᔪᓂ (SFO)
description:
(Translations in French and Inuktitut to follow/Veuillez faire défiler vers le bas pour le français/ᑕᐅᓄᙵᐅᒃᑲᓐᓂᕈᕕᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᖅᓯᒪᔪᖅ)

The Supervisor, Financial Operations is responsible for direct supervision operational performance of financial transactions processing activities of Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable journal entries, vendor and customer maintenance. The role also oversees the collection and recording of assessment revenue from Northwest Territories and Nunavut employers, and the administration of disbursements under contribution agreements. The Supervisor ensures financial transactions follow strict internal controls and are processed efficiently through the organization's financial systems, including CAAPS, the accounting system, the invoice processing system, and corporate payment cards.

The Supervisor, Financial Operations ensures compliance with relevant legislation, regulations, policies and procedures, and is responsible for maintaining regular sub-ledger to general ledger reconciliations and the monthly and annual reconciliation of balance sheet accounts. The position exercises delegated payment authority and is accountable for the integrity of the transaction records supporting the corporate financial statements and the annual audit by the Office of the Auditor General.

The position provides backup coverage for the Senior Payroll Specialist and is cross trained in payroll and benefit transaction processing to provide continuity of service during absences.

Here are a few ways you will make a difference:
  • Supervising financial transaction processing for Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, contribution agreements, vendor maintenance, duty travel, corporate cards and General Ledger transactions for all client divisions.
  • Maintaining the Accounts Receivable sub-ledgers and is responsible for all AR processes, adjustments and monthly reconciliations for approximately 4,000 employer accounts.
  • Supervising the processing of all Accounts Payable, including CAAPS, claimant, medical vendor, general and administrative, corporate card, petty cash and employee travel payments, from request to payment. Provides technical expertise and advice on best practices to the WSCC staff.
  • Performing data integrity checks during the integration of transactions from multiple platforms into the accounting system and performs claims-related reconciliations. Contributes to the achievement of Employer Services goals and strategic priorities.
  • Administering financial disbursements under contribution agreements, ensuring payments are made in accordance with agreement terms, approved payment plans and WSCC policy.
  • Supporting the Finance unit in achieving the mandate and goals of the unit.

What you bring to the role:
  • Successful completion of an undergraduate degree, one year of experience supervising, and one of the following:
    • Completion of four (4) competencies of the Canadian CPA Professional Education Program (PEP) with three (3) years of accounting experience.
    • OR an equivalency; An Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) designation with three (3) years of directly related experience.
What we offer:
  • The opportunity to positively impact the quality of life for workers across the NWT and Nunavut.
  • A Northern Living Allowance of $3,700 for Yellowknife.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • A superior benefits package and enrollment in the Public Service Pension Plan.
  • Learning and development programs and funding dedicated to your career growth.
  • Generous leave entitlements and a workplace culture that supports a healthy work-life balance.
  • A culturally diverse workforce that embraces change and welcomes your life experience.
  • Federal and territorial tax incentives such as the NWT or Nunavut personal tax credits and the Northern Residents Tax Deductions.
Criminal Record Check: Candidates must be able to provide a satisfactory criminal record check. Failure to provide a satisfactory check may deem you disqualified from the competition.

Indigenous Employment Policy: Candidates must clearly state their eligibility in order to receive priority consideration under the Indigenous Employment Policy.

Equivalencies: May be considered based on a one-year of directly related experience equivalent to one year of education or one year of education for one year of experience. However, combinations of education and experience must often be considered on a case-by-case basis. For a full list of equivalencies that will be considered for this role, please contact human resources.

If you have a disability and you require support during the hiring process, you are encouraged to identify your needs if you are contacted for an assignment or interview so that you may be accommodated during the hiring process.

The Workers’ Safety and Compensation Commission’s (WSCC) vision is to eliminate workplace diseases and injuries. Le ou la superviseur(e), Opérations financières, est responsable de la supervision directe du rendement opérationnel des activités de traitement des transactions financières liées aux écritures comptables des comptes créditeurs et débiteurs, ainsi que de la maintenance des comptes des fournisseurs et des clients.       OU

Ce que nous vous offrons:

  • L’accès à des programmes d’apprentissage et de perfectionnement, et l’affectation de fonds à votre avancement professionnel
  • Une culture organisationnelle et des droits aux congés qui favorisent et appuient une saine conciliation du travail et de la vie personnelle
  • Un effectif diversifié sur le plan culturel, qui fait place au changement et accueille votre expérience vécue
  • L’appartenance à une équipe qui a des retombées positives sur la qualité de vie des travailleurs du Nunavut et des Territoires du Nord-Ouest
  • Des incitatifs financiers des gouvernements fédéral et territorial, comme les crédits d’impôt personnels (territoriaux) et la déduction fiscale pour les résidents du Nord
