title: RM Agribusiness Livestock Specialist
description:
2.0 THE ROLE PURPOSE

The RM Agribusiness Livestock Specialist will be responsible for developing, managing, and growing Equity Bank Tanzania's livestock and livestock-related agribusiness portfolio. The role will provide specialized management and technical support to livestock farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, dairy groups, ranchers, pastoralist organizations, aggregators, processors, abattoirs, feed manufacturers, input suppliers, livestock traders, off-takers, and other actors across the livestock value chain. The role holder will identify and develop quality livestock financing opportunities, build a sustainable pipeline of agricultural customers, deepen existing relationships, and facilitate access to appropriate financial products including working capital, asset finance, agricultural loans, trade finance, deposits, transaction banking, and digital financial services. The RM will serve as a technical and commercial resource on livestock value chains, providing insights on livestock production systems, animal health, feed and nutrition, breeding, market dynamics, seasonality, cash flows, pricing, value addition, and associated agricultural risks.

3.0 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Livestock Agribusiness Relationship Management Develop and manage strategic relationships with livestock farmers, pastoralist groups, cooperatives, dairy groups, ranchers, aggregators, traders, processors, abattoirs, feed manufacturers, input suppliers, and Off takers. Build and maintain a strong pipeline Of quality livestock and agribusiness customers and financing opportunities. Conduct customer visits, livestock farm visits, business reviews, value chain assessments, and relationship management activities. Understand customers' livestock production models, business cycles, cash flows, financing requirements, operational challenges, and growth opportunities. Develop and implement customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio deepening strategies. Identify opportunities to cross-sell deposits, loans, insurance, payments, digital banking, and other relevant financial solutions. Act as the primary relationship contact for assigned livestock customers and coordinate resolution of customer issues with relevant internal teams. Livestock Value Chain Development • Develop strong technical and commercial knowledge Of priority livestock value chains, including dairy, beef, poultry, goats, sheep and other commercially viable livestock enterprises. Map livestock value chains to identify commercially viable financing opportunities, gaps, risks, and opportunities for value addition. Identify strategic anchor companies, processors, aggregators, cooperatives, feed companies, veterinary service providers, and Off-takers that can support structured livestock financing. Facilitate linkages between livestock producers, input suppliers, veterinary service providers, processors, markets, and financial services. Support development of livestock financing models based on production cycles, herd/flock economics, milk production, meat production, poultry cycles, and other livestock business models. Monitor livestock market trends, livestock and feed prices, disease outbreaks, weather conditions, regulations, market access, and other factors affecting the portfolio. Identify opportunities for livestock value addition, processing, aggregation, cold- chain development, and market expansion. Livestock Production & Technical Support Provide technical guidance on commercially viable livestock production Systems and business models. Support farmers and livestock enterprises to improve productivity, profitability, animal husbandry, and business management. Promote good practices in animal nutrition, feed management, breeding, housing, animal health, biosecurity, hygiene, and record keeping. Support adoption Of climate-smart livestock practices, including improved feeding systems, water management, pasture management, manure utilization, improved breeds, and resilient production Systems. Coordinate with qualified veterinary, livestock extension, and technical partners where specialized animal health or production interventions are required. Promote improved farm and livestock records to strengthen financial management and customer bankability. Support farmers to understand the relationship between livestock productivity, cash flows, profitability, and financing requirements. Credit & Portfolio Management • Originate quality livestock and agribusiness loan applications in accordance with the Bank's credit policies. Conduct preliminary assessment of customers' financial performance, business models, cash flows, repayment capacity, collateral, livestock assets, and production risks. prepare high-quality credit proposals and supporting documentation for consideration through the Bank's credit approval processes. Assess livestock-related financing requirements including working capital, livestock purchase, breeding stock, feed, equipment, dairy infrastructure, poultry houses, ranch development, cold storage, transport, and processing equipment. Monitor financed customers and livestock portfolios to identify emerging risks and opportunities. Monitor Portfolio at Risk (PAR) and proactively initiate remedial actions for stressed accounts. Conduct periodic customer and business visits to assess operational performance, utilization of financing, livestock assets, and repayment capacity. Ensure compliance with credit policies, KYC, AML, environmental and social requirements, and all applicable Bank policies and regulations. Work closely with Credit, Risk, Collections, Legal, Operations, and other relevant functions to manage portfolio risks and resolve account issues. Deposit & Transaction Banking Growth Mobilize deposits from livestock farmers, cooperatives, dairy groups, traders, processors, abattoirs, feed companies, and other livestock value chain actors. promote appropriate transaction banking and digital payment solutions across livestock value chains. Facilitate digitization and traceability Of payments between producers, aggregators, processors, and off-takers. Identify opportunities to increase customer wallet share through relevant banking and financial products. Support efficient collection and disbursement mechanisms for livestock businesses and organized farmer groups. Farmer & Customer Capacity Development Organize livestock farmer and agribusiness sensitization forums on financial literacy, banking products, business management, responsible borrowing, and financial planning. Support farmers and livestock enterprises to develop business plans, financial records, cash-flow projections, and financing proposals. Fur Intemal Use Only Facilitate training and awareness on good livestock husbandry, animal nutrition, animal health, biosecurity, climate-smart livestock production, and market requirements. Support farmer groups and cooperatives to strengthen governance, record keeping, financial management, and commercial operations. • Promote responsible use of agricultural finance and improve customer capacity to manage loan proceeds and repayment obligations. Partnerships & Ecosystem Development Identify and develop strategic partnerships with government livestock authorities, development partners, NGOs, veterinary institutions, research organizations, processors, feed manufacturers, breeders, insurance providers, and off-takers. Build relationships with livestock associations, cooperatives, dairy unions, ranching organizations, and other industry bodies. Support development Of blended finance, guarantee, grant, and risk-sharing facilities that can unlock livestock-sector financing. Participate in livestock exhibitions, agricultural shows, field days, farmer forums, trade fairs, and stakeholder meetings representing Equity Bank Tanzania. Maintain an updated database of strategic livestock ecosystem stakeholders and Commercial opportunities. Data, Monitoring & Reporting Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer, pipeline, portfolio, and value chain information in the Bank's approved systems. Track performance against targets for livestock loans, deposits, customer acquisition, portfolio quality, transaction volumes, and farmer/value chain reach. Prepare accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on commercial performance, pipeline development, portfolio quality, customer engagement, risks, and opportunities. Analyse livestock-sector data and market intelligence to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. • Collaborate with Monitoring & Evaluation and other teams to collect and validate program and commercial performance data. Undertake any other business activities as required by organizational needs.

4.0 CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

Financial Growth in livestock and agribusiness loans and advances within the assigned portfolio. Growth in deposits and transaction banking revenues from livestock value chain customers. Quality and value of livestock financing pipeline. Achievement of agreed disbursement and portfolio growth targets. Maintenance Of acceptable PAR and non-performing loan levels. Growth in the number and value of active livestock agribusiness customers. Growth in farmer, cooperative, aggregator, processor, trader, and off-taker accounts. Number and value Of Strategic livestock partnerships developed. Number and value Of blended finance, guarantee, grant, or risk-sharing opportunities supported. Number Of livestock farmers and value chain actors reached, onboarded, and activated

title: Principal Sales Engineer
description:
Why join Upscale, Inc.

Upscale, Inc., is building the high-performance infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Backed by over $300M in funding and rapid global adoption, we are scaling systems designed for the world’s most demanding AI workloads.

We focus on first-principles engineering across silicon, systems, and networking—where performance, scale, and execution are critical. Our team is talent-dense and high-performing. We value ownership, technical rigor, and speed, and we offer the opportunity to work on foundational problems with immediate, real-world impact.

If you’re looking to do high-impact work, move fast, and help define the infrastructure behind the future of AI—Upscale is where you can produce meaningful work at the frontier—and operate at a high standard.


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Sales Engineer to drive complex solution sales across cutting-edge AI infrastructure markets. In this role, you will serve as the technical lead throughout the sales process, partnering with Account Managers, Product, and Engineering teams to understand customer requirements, design innovative solutions, and deliver compelling technical presentations and demonstrations.

The ideal candidate has a strong grasp of ASIC/semiconductor-level design and tradeoffs and deep, hands-on expertise in scale-up networking and interconnect technologies alongside a solid understanding of traditional scale-out networking and modern network operating systems (e.g., SONiC, EOS, Junos). You should be fluent in the xPU/NIC ecosystem and competitive offerings, and conversant in emerging scale-up/interconnect standards such as ESUN, UALink (UAL), and SUE.

You will work closely with customers to architect solutions that align with their business and technical goals, while representing their feedback internally to shape our product roadmap.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with exposure to strategic customers, emerging technologies, and industry-shaping innovations.

Responsibilities

· Manage high-value global customer accounts in partnership with the Account Manager.

· Drive complex, full-cycle solution sales from ASIC-level to system-level and rack-scale deployments.

· Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, drawing on chip, board, and system-level expertise to guide them through solution design, evaluation, and adoption.

· Design and propose solutions leveraging Upscale’s product portfolio.

· Lead technical discovery, gather customer requirements, and develop proof-of-concept validation and demos to demonstrate product and solution capabilities across AI clusters - GPU, NIC, xPU, and switch tray platforms.

· Deliver compelling technical presentations, product demonstrations, and feature deep-dives to customer stakeholders.

· Identify and develop new business opportunities within both existing and prospective accounts.

· Collaborate with Sales and Product teams to respond to RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other sales proposals with tailored technical input on ASIC, scale-up interconnect, and networking architecture.

· Partner cross-functionally with engineering, product management, and operations teams to deliver on customer requirements and align product roadmaps with market needs, including emerging standards such as ESUN, SUE, ETH, IP and UALink.

· Represent Upscale at industry events, conferences, and technical forums; contribute thought leadership through white papers and technical publications on AI scale-up networking and semiconductor architecture.

· Continuously invest in professional development by pursuing technical training and staying informed about industry trends, technologies, and competitive offerings.

Requirements

· Minimum of 10 years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solutions Architect in the AI infrastructure, semiconductor, or networking sector. Candidates coming from a Field Application Engineering (FAE) background with strong customer-facing experience are strongly encouraged to apply.

· Proven track record in selling or supporting complex network infrastructure and semiconductor/ASIC solutions to hyperscalers, enterprise customers, and cloud providers.

· Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

· Strong foundation in ASIC/semiconductor architecture, with the ability to speak fluently to chip-level tradeoffs (power, thermals, SerDes, packaging) as they relate to system design.

· Hands-on experience with scale-up networking and interconnect technologies as well as scale-out data center and WAN networking.

· Working knowledge of major network operating systems such as SONiC, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos, Cisco IOS, etc.

· Fluency with the GPU/NIC ecosystem and familiarity with competitive xPU offerings and vendors.

· Familiarity with emerging scale-up and interconnect standards, including ESUN, UALink (UAL), and SUE.

· Clear understanding of AI-driven workloads and associated data center and network architecture requirements, including frontend and backend AI network design.

· Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical and executive stakeholders.

· Demonstrated ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams in sales, product, and engineering.

· Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%, including international travel.

Where you fall within that range depends on your experience, skills, and impact—we benchmark against internal levels to keep things fair and consistent.

Equal Opportunity

Upscale, Inc., is building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

Accessibility & Accommodations

We’re committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need accommodations at any stage, just reach out to us at hiring@upscaleai.com—we’re happy to help. Note: This inbox is only for accommodation requests.

title: Batching Operator - 1st Shift
description:

Dairy Farmers of America (DFA) is a farmer‑owned cooperative and one of the largest dairy companies in the world. We are committed to producing high‑quality dairy products while supporting our farmer‑owners, employees, and the communities where we live and work. title: Clinical Supervisor - Long Term Foster Care
description:
*Applicants who apply through third-party sites (Indeed, LinkedIn, etc.) will receive an email from Isolved to complete their application.*

This position will be split 50/50 between Denver and Fort Collins. Home office will be determined based on location of candidate.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Lutheran Family Services Rocky Mountains is a nonprofit, human services agency committed to community safety, support, and resiliency. Since 1948, LFSRM has provided support, guidance, and resource coordination to individuals and families, regardless of race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, or age through family and refugee services. We believe that all people, from the newborn to the most elderly, are valued members of our community. If you want to impact your community while serving alongside other amazing professionals, Lutheran Family Services Rocky Mountains welcomes you to apply.

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

The Long-Term Foster Care (LTFC) program at Lutheran Family Services Rocky Mountains (LFSRM) provides care and support to youth from other countries, who are here on their own, as they wait for their immigration case to be resolved so they can transition to a more long term program or living arrangement. The youth are placed with licensed foster families and attend public school while they are in the program, allowing them to have more normalized experiences in family based environment.

JOB SUMMARY & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Clinical Supervisor is responsible for supporting and ensuring the comprehensive service delivery of clinical services in the program. This position will offer consultation and trauma-informed expertise to program staff and stakeholders to promote stable foster placements and provide clinical feedback. Additionally, the Clinical Supervisor will conduct trainings during the onboarding process for new staff and continually, as needed. This position includes the direct supervision of the therapeutic team and may support direct client treatment services, based on program needs. This position will support both Long Term Foster Care programs- Denver and Ft Collins.

REQUIRED COMPETANCIES

Occupational Competencies

  • Meet standards of practice: Familiarity with social work practice, human development, child welfare system and family systems, including appropriate local, state, and federal regulatory rules.
  • Apply therapeutic services: Familiarity with assessment, care planning, facilitation, coordination, and advocating for supports on behalf of and in collaboration with an individual.
  • Apply crisis intervention: Experience with crisis management, problem solving, and mediation best practices.
  • Legal requirements: Familiarity with the legal system as it applies to child welfare.
  • Deliver services within diverse cultural communities: Skills and sensitivity in working with youth and families from a variety of cultural and ethnic backgrounds with a variety of challenges.
  • Communicate professionally with colleagues in other fields: Ability to communicate professionally and cooperate with members of the other professions involved with the youth.

Foundational Competencies

  • Active Listening: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting.
  • Critical Thinking: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
  • Social Perceptiveness: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

EXAMPLE ACTIVITIES

  • Provide clinical supervision, leadership, and training to therapeutic team.
  • Support and supervise the therapeutic team with service delivery, documentation and client related issues.
  • Provide direct therapeutic services to clients and community as needed including group and family therapy.
  • Facilitate comprehensive clinical related training to staff and stakeholders.
  • Ensure federal, state, and program's internal documentation practices and reporting requirements are met in following with contract and licensing standards.
  • Participate in meetings with stakeholders and offer clinical feedback regarding client treatment needs.
  • Participate in data collection and review to evaluate individual and program success- set goals for improvement based on overall strategies and objectives.
  • May participate in on call rotation.

TRANSPORTATION

Must maintain a valid driver's license and carry personal auto liability insurance at the level of $100,000/300,000/100,000.

  • Frequent local regional travel. May be required to transport clients in personal vehicle.

REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in psychology, sociology, or other relevant behavioral science in which clinical experience is a program requirement.
  • Two (2) years of postgraduate direct service delivery experience.
  • Clinical License- LCSW, LPC, LMFT, or LP.
  • Bi-lingual English and Spanish strongly preferred.

REASONABLE ACCOMODATIONS

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed in this job description are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

VACCINATION POLICY

Due to contract requirements from this program, staff in this Long-Term Foster Care Program who work directly with youth must present proof of immunization or immunity (within 120 days of hire) to the following diseases: Varicella, MMR, Tdap, and annual Influenza; or an approved exemption from Human Resources.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Inventory Control Coordinator/Specialist
description:
Position: Inventory Control Coordinator/Specialist

Department: Supply Chain

Reports to Procurement Manager

Direct Reports: None

Classification: Hourly / Non-Exempt

General Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Inventory Control Specialist to support our growing Supply Chain team. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory, coordinating receiving activities, managing documentation, supporting reporting and month-end activities, and helping improve inventory and warehouse processes. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams including Customer Service, Logistics, Inventory Management, Supply Planning, Quality Assurance, R&D, and Sourcing.

Inventory Control & Operations

  • Perform cycle counts and physical inventory audits to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Investigate and reconcile inventory variances and identify root causes.
  • Maintain accurate inventory information in ERP/WMS systems.
  • Monitor inbound and outbound inventory movements and ensure proper documentation.
  • Review and process receiving documents and support invoice approval activities.
  • Support aging reports, inventory shortage analysis, and other inventory reporting.
  • Maintain PODs, BOLs, packing slips, and supporting documentation for accounting, claims, and deduction resolution.
  • Partner with production for planning.
  • Assist with procurement duties and projects as needed.

Receiving & Warehouse Coordination

  • Support receiving activities across two plants and local cold-storage facilities.
  • Ensure products are properly labeled, stored, organized, and documented.
  • Work with warehouse personnel to maintain efficient storage practices and inventory flow.



Data & Reporting

  • Perform accurate data entry and maintain inventory records.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports.
  • Analyze inventory trends, usage, discrepancies, and shrinkage.
  • Monitor overstocked, slow-moving, aging, and at-risk-of-expiration inventory.
  • Support month-end inventory activities and reporting.



Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve inventory and warehouse processes.
  • Support the development and implementation of SOPs.
  • Help improve inventory accuracy, material flow, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in strategic Supply Chain projects and initiatives.

Minimum Qualification and Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, supply chain, logistics, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience with inventory software, ERP/WMS systems, spreadsheets, and data entry.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment
  • Ability to effectively prioritize work and complete urgent tasks in a timely manner
  • Curiosity to understand how data impacts the customer experience and business operations
  • Must have a valid Californian Driver’s License with a clear driving record.



Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Ability to lift up to 40–50 lbs. as needed.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and move throughout warehouse and production areas for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in warehouses, production, and cold-storage environments.
  • Ability to work in a hot, cold, wet, and/or loud environment.
  • Ability to safely perform required duties in an operational environment.





Schedule

Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm

Onsite in San Leandro; Occasional travel to Oakland Facility.

title: General Cardiology and Heart Failure ICU Clinical Pharmacy Specialist
description:
Joining our team comes with several benefits, including\:

  • Competitive rate of pay
  • Sign on bonus up to $5,000
  • Free parking

Overview

UH Cleveland Medical Center (UH CMC) is seeking a highly motivated General Cardiology and Heart Failure ICU Clinical Pharmacy Specialist to join our pharmacy team. This position will provide dedicated clinical pharmacy services to the inpatient cardiology consult service and Heart Failure Intensive Care Unit (HF ICU), serving as an integral member of the multidisciplinary cardiovascular care team.

The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist will serve as a subject matter expert in cardiovascular pharmacotherapy, working collaboratively with cardiologists, heart failure specialists, advanced practice providers, nurses, and pharmacy colleagues to optimize medication therapy, improve patient outcomes, and advance quality initiatives within the cardiology and heart failure service lines at UH Cleveland Medical Center.

Position Summary

This General Cardiology and Heart Failure ICU Clinical Pharmacy Specialist will\:

  • Serve as the pharmacotherapy expert for patients cared for by the inpatient cardiology consult service and Heart Failure ICU.
  • Participate in daily multidisciplinary rounds with the cardiology and heart failure teams and contribute to individualized patient care plans.
  • Optimize medication therapy through evidence-based recommendations related to cardiovascular and heart failure pharmacotherapy.
  • Provide therapeutic drug monitoring and medication management for high-risk and complex cardiovascular therapies.
  • Support guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) implementation and optimization across the continuum of cardiovascular care.
  • Develop and maintain clinical guidelines, protocols, and best practices related to cardiology and heart failure pharmacotherapy.
  • Lead and participate in quality improvement, medication safety, and resource stewardship initiatives.
  • Support clinical teaching, research, and scholarly activities within the Department of Pharmacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily multidisciplinary patient care rounds and clinical discussions with the inpatient cardiology consult service and Heart Failure ICU teams.
  • Provide evidence-based recommendations regarding medication selection, dosing, monitoring, and optimization for cardiovascular disease states.
  • Assist in the management of complex cardiovascular therapies including anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents, antiarrhythmics, vasoactive agents, inotropes, and advanced heart failure therapies.
  • Promote guideline-directed medication therapy for patients with heart failure and other cardiovascular conditions.
  • Perform therapeutic drug monitoring and pharmacokinetic consultation when applicable.
  • Monitor for and prevent adverse drug events, medication errors, and drug-related complications.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain clinical policies, guidelines, protocols, and order sets related to cardiovascular pharmacotherapy.
  • Promote adherence to formulary standards and provide guidance regarding appropriate medication utilization.
  • Collaborate with physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing staff, and pharmacists to optimize patient outcomes.
  • Document clinical interventions and associated outcomes.
  • Serve as a resource and educator for pharmacists, physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacy residents, and pharmacy students.
  • Participate in departmental committees, quality improvement initiatives, research activities, and medication-use evaluations.
  • Provide Clinical Pharmacy Services (drug information, drug therapy monitoring, patient specific consultations, healthcare staff education, pharmacoepidemiology and pharmacoeconomic evaluations in selected patient populations)
  • Investigate/research/report adverse drug reactions
  • Participate in Medication Safety and Therapeutics (MS&T) Committee process\: evaluate requests for new drug usage and old formulary drug relevance and review therapeutic classes for relevance, assist in maintaining and updating the system formulary
  • Serve as an informational and patient problem solving resource for Clinical Pharmacists and other healthcare professionals
  • Provide continuing education to Clinical Pharmacist staff
  • Documentation of clinical activities
  • Serve as a preceptor for pharmacy residents and pharmacy students
  • Actively participate in local and system committees and workgroups pertaining to the Clinical Pharmacy Specialist’s area of expertise

Teaching and Research Opportunities

This position offers extensive opportunities to\:

  • Precept PGY1 Pharmacy Residents and PGY2 Critical Care Pharmacy Residents.
  • Provide learning experiences for APPE pharmacy students.
  • Deliver educational programs to pharmacists, physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing staff, residents, and students.
  • Participate in clinical research and scholarly publication activities.
  • Collaborate with academic partners and contribute to advancing cardiovascular pharmacy practice.
  • Participate in cardiovascular quality improvement initiatives and outcomes-based research.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
  • For specific duties and responsibilities, refer to documentation provided by the department during orientation.
  • Must abide by all requirements to safely and securely maintain Protected Health Information (PHI) for our patients. Annual training, the UH Code of Conduct and UH policies and procedures are in place to address appropriate use of PHI in the workplace.

About UH Cleveland Medical Center

UH Cleveland Medical Center is a 1,000+ bed quaternary care, Level I Trauma Academic Medical Center located in Cleveland's historic University Circle district. The institution supports a robust clinical pharmacy specialist program that includes expertise in Medical ICU, Cardiac ICU, Cardiothoracic ICU, Neuro ICU, Trauma ICU, Heart Failure ICU, Emergency Medicine, Internal Medicine, Surgical ICU, Solid Organ Transplant, Oncology, Infectious Diseases, Antimicrobial Stewardship, Psychiatry, Geriatrics, and Women's Health.

As part of our progressive pharmacy department, this specialist will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across the University Hospitals Health System while helping advance innovative patient care initiatives and clinical pharmacy practice.

Why Join Us?

  • Make a meaningful impact on the care of patients with complex cardiovascular disease and advanced heart failure.
  • Join a highly collaborative multidisciplinary cardiology and heart failure team.
  • Work within a nationally recognized academic medical center environment.
  • Access strong opportunities for professional growth, teaching, leadership, and research.
  • Help shape cardiovascular pharmacy services, medication-use practices, and quality initiatives across the cardiology and heart failure service lines.
  • Collaborate closely with critical care and cardiology pharmacy specialists to advance cardiovascular pharmacotherapy throughout the health system.
  • Work within a progressive pharmacy department committed to innovation, clinical excellence, and advancing pharmacist practice.

Youth who are court‑ordered to home incarceration or home supervision are processed through the Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ) and Detention Alternatives Coordinators (DAC). DACs refer these youth to a Kentucky United Methodist Children’s Homes case workers.
The Case Worker is responsible for monitoring each youth to ensure compliance with court mandates. Monitoring may include the use of GPS equipment placed on the youth or by in home supervision. Case Workers conduct weekly face‑to‑face visits and daily check‑ins by phone. Weekly performance reports are submitted to the referring DAC.

1. Minimum age of 21 with a high school diploma; prior case management or juvenile services
experience preferred.
2. Valid Kentucky driver’s license and willingness to undergo an intensive background check.
3. Reliable transportation for extensive travel.
4. Home office with laptop, printer/scanner, and a reliable cell phone service plan

Preferred Qualities:
1. Self‑motivated and able to work independently after training.
2. Strong computer and communication skills.
3. Ability to manage one’s own schedule and meet deadlines consistently.
4. Ideal for individuals with experience in the Department of Juvenile Justice, corrections, law
enforcement, or the school system.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
1. Maintain required contact with assigned youth, including at least one weekly face‑to‑face visit and daily phone communication.
2. Remain accessible by cell phone for on‑call responsibilities at all times, or notify the Director of ATD Services when unavailable.
3. Receive and process referrals and intakes according to Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ) requirements.
4. Maintain working knowledge of GPS tracking equipment, including proper use and upkeep.

title: Director - Strategic Meetings and Congresses
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Are you a proven leader in medical events, meetings, and congress execution ready to elevate HCP engagements across the life sciences industry? As the Director for Strategic Meetings and Congresses, you will build, mentor, and lead an elite event planning team responsible for executing high-impact, home-office organized events; including Advisory Boards, Consultant Engagements, Investigator Meetings, Speaker Training, and Major Congresses. In this high-impact operational leadership role, you will bridge high-level commercial strategy with flawless execution. Partnering directly with the Director of Strategy & Business Development and Customer Account Teams, you will operationalize cutting-edge event capabilities, transform customer relationships, and establish the gold standard for compliant, high-touch HCP experiences. If you are an ambitious team builder who excels at scaling complex operations, managing top-tier vendors, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes, this is your platform to make a lasting mark.

What You'll Do

  • Operational Excellence & Leadership: Recruit, onboard, and empower a high-performing team of event planners. Direct daily operations, workload allocation, service quality, and SLA compliance to ensure consistent execution excellence
  • Strategy & Capability Launch: Partner seamlessly with the Director of Strategy & Business Development and Services Delivery Leads to design, launch, and continuously refine operational frameworks for home-office organized HCP events and major congresses
  • Customer Account Support: Serve as an operational anchor for Customer Account Teams, driving new customer large event initiatives, process alignment, joining Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and pre/post-conference briefings
  • Vendor & Technology Ecosystem Governance: Vet, onboard, and manage 3rd-party event technologies, agencies, and vendors to build a best-in-class, scalable outsourced support network
  • Compliance & Financial Oversight: Direct event budgets, operational reporting, risk escalation, and financial health. Develop robust SOPs, operational workflows, and strict compliance protocols across all customer programs
  • Executive & Customer Engagement: Co-lead high-stakes new business pitch presentations, operational reviews, and strategic alignment sessions with customer executives and internal leadership

Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive operational leadership experience within pharmaceutical/biotech companies or top-tier healthcare marketing/event agencies managing complex HCP events and major congresses
  • 3+ years of direct experience recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing event planning teams
  • Customer Service Excellence: Dedicated commitment to delivering an extraordinary customer experience, with proven mastery in customer relationship management, rapid escalation resolution, and maintaining flawless SLA standards
  • Commercial & Strategic Savvy: Proven success collaborating with Strategy, Sales, and Customer Account leadership to drive account growth, customer retention, and SLA excellence
  • Operations Architect: Demonstrated ability to build SOPs, design scalable operational workflows, manage vendors, and handle financial oversight
  • High-Stakes Problem Solver: Outstanding conflict resolution, project management, and critical-thinking skills in fast-paced, high-pressure environments
  • Tech-Savvy Operational Lead: Hands-on experience with enterprise event technologies (e.g., Vault Events Management, Cvent, virtual event platforms) and advanced mastery of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with the ability to engage, persuade, and build trust with senior stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Veeva Product Experience: Direct experience with Link Workflow, Vault CRM Suite, or Vault CRM Events Management platforms
  • Specialized Background: Prior leadership experience directly within a Life Science Company or a premier Life Sciences Event Agency managing complex HCP engagements and congresses
  • Industry Credentials: Certified HMCC (Healthcare Meeting Compliance Certificate)
  • Compliance Mastery: In-depth knowledge of compliance guidelines, Sunshine Act reporting, and FMV standards for HCP engagements
  • Agency Governance: Proven experience managing large-scale congress budgets and external third-party meeting management agencies

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

Perks & Benefits

Compensation

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

title: Content Strategist
description:
About BURST

BURST believes that if oral care is health care, it should be accessible. We make thoughtfully designed, dentist-backed oral care, from sonic toothbrushes and water flossers to floss, whitening and breath care, for adults and kids.

What sets us apart is our community. BURST was built alongside dental professionals, and our Ambassador community of hygienists, dentists and dental students shapes everything we make. Through BURST Labs, those ambassadors co-create and test new products with us. We sell direct-to-consumer, on Amazon and TikTok Shop, and in national and regional retailers.

About the role

The Content Strategist owns the thinking behind BURST's content: what we make, why it will work, where it lives, and how it grows the business. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you'll turn product launches, clinical credibility, customer insight and cultural moments into content people watch, save, share and search for.

This is not a traditional social media manager role. You won't produce every asset yourself. You'll set the strategy and direction, then partner with our creative content agency, paid media, retention (email and SMS), ambassador and retail teams, plus our external agency partners, to bring it to life in one consistent BURST voice.

You'll also brief creative that flexes across mediums. One strong concept should work as an organic post, a creator video and a performance ad, so every shoot and edit pulls its weight in organic and paid.

What you'll own:

Content strategy and planning

  • Build and own BURST's annual, quarterly and monthly content calendar across owned, earned and organic channels.
  • Align content to product launches, licensed and co-branded partnerships, retail moments, seasonal promotions and community events like our annual Ambassador celebration.
  • Turn launches into stories, not just promotional posts, with clear angles, hooks and messaging for each audience (adults, parents and kids, dental professionals).
  • Write content briefs, scripts, captions and long-form copy when needed; set editorial direction for everything else.
  • Keep every piece on brand, applying our tone-of-voice system and messaging framework across channels.

Organic social and distribution

  • Own organic strategy for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest, adapting each idea to the platform's format, algorithm and audience rather than reposting.
  • Partner with our TikTok Shop and affiliate agency so organic content, creator content and shoppable content work together.
  • Build a repeatable organic growth engine: test formats, learn fast, scale what works.

Community, ambassador and creator content

  • Turn our dental professional Ambassador community into a content advantage: UGC programs, expert explainers, testimonials and creator collaborations.
  • Tell the BURST Labs story so customers see how ambassadors help create our products.
  • Brief and direct influencers and creators with clear objectives, talking points and guardrails.

Creative direction

  • Give the creative content team clear direction: concepts, hooks, shot lists, scripts, moodboards, references and AI image briefs.
  • Partner on photo and video shoots so we capture content for social, email, site, Amazon and retail in one pass.
  • Know what a great asset looks like before anyone makes it.

Owned channels, search and discoverability

  • Shape content for the D2C site (landing pages, product education, blog) and Amazon listings and A+ content.
  • Develop SEO and AI-search (AIO/GEO) strategy so BURST shows up when people ask about oral care.
  • Supply retention with content themes and copy for email and SMS campaigns and flows.
  • Keep messaging connected across site, marketplace, email, organic and paid so every channel tells the same story.

Creative briefing across organic and paid

  • Write creative briefs built to flex: one concept, planned from the start as organic, creator and performance versions.
  • Define hooks, angles, messaging and format variations (cut-downs, aspect ratios, openers) so the creative team can produce for multiple placements in one pass.
  • Partner with our paid media team and agencies so performance creative reflects the brand strategy and organic learnings.
  • Flag top-performing organic, creator and ambassador content that is ready to be adapted or boosted for paid.
  • Use paid and organic creative results together to sharpen future briefs.

Insight, measurement and optimization

  • Research what customers search for, talk about and engage with; track trends, competitors and cultural moments.
  • Set content KPIs across organic and paid, and report monthly to the CMO on what is moving reach, engagement, traffic, community growth, creative efficiency and revenue.
  • Use performance data to refine the strategy continuously.

AI and workflow

  • Help roll out AI-assisted workflows, including our in-house AI copywriting tool, to raise content quality and speed while protecting brand voice.
  • Build processes, templates and approval flows that let a lean team ship more, better content.

Compliance

  • Work with leadership to keep claims accurate and substantiated, and ensure creator and ambassador content follows FTC disclosure guidelines.

What we're looking for:

  • 4–6 years in content strategy, organic social or content marketing, ideally at a consumer, DTC, CPG, beauty, wellness or personal care brand.
  • A portfolio showing content strategies you built and the results they drove.
  • Deep, current knowledge of Instagram, Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest: formats, algorithms and what makes people stop scrolling.
  • Strong writing and editing, with the range to move from a 3-second hook to a long-form explainer in one brand voice.
  • Experience turning product launches and business goals into content ideas and calendars.
  • Clear creative judgment and the ability to direct creators, designers and videographers.
  • Experience with creator, influencer, ambassador or UGC programs.
  • Working knowledge of SEO and emerging AI-search discovery.
  • A data-informed approach: comfortable with platform analytics, GA4 and Shopify reporting, and using results to change course.
  • Experience briefing creative for both organic and performance use, with an understanding of what makes an ad convert versus what makes a post travel. Experience working with agencies and cross-functional teams (paid, retention, creative, retail).
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in content and ad creative workflows.
  • Strong project management; you can run multiple launches at once without dropping details.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in health, wellness or oral care, or with regulated or claims-sensitive categories.
  • Experience with Amazon listing content, TikTok Shop or retail marketing.
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, Shopify and social scheduling and listening tools.

You'll be a strong fit if:

  • You've looked at a brand's TikTok and known exactly why it wasn't working, and what it should post instead.
  • You naturally think in: Audience → Insight → Idea → Hook → Format → Distribution → Result.
  • You can make flossing interesting. Seriously.
  • You bring an egoless approach to great work, a bias for action and a sense of humor.

What this role is not:

  • Scheduling and reposting content.
  • Writing generic captions.
  • Following a calendar someone else built.
  • Waiting to be told what to create.

The goal: make BURST the oral care brand people discover organically, trust, talk about, search for and share.

Why Join BURST Oral Care?

  • Opportunity to make a direct impact on the company's success.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Chance to make a meaningful impact on oral health and wellness.
  • Annual Salary + Commission
Benefits:
  • Fully Remote company
  • Equipment provided
  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • 12 Paid Holidays
  • Unlimited PTO
**This is a rule remote role that requires residency in the United States.**

title: Project Administrator
description:
Who We Are

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

Overview

Every project we deliver at VEC-US runs on a strong administrative backbone: clean setup, accurate billing, the right paperwork in the right place, and a PM who always knows where their project stands financially. The Project Administrator is that backbone for a portfolio of projects, from the day a contract lands through the final invoice at closeout. This is a full-time hourly role based in the Tracy, CA (CV2) office, reporting to the Project Admin Lead, with a pay range of $26 to $32 per hour depending on experience.

The Project Administrator works side by side with Project Managers and the Operations team and is the person they count on for the details: what the contract actually says, what the client needs on every invoice, and what is still waiting on a signature. The Project Admin Lead reviews work before it goes to clients or accounting, so there is real support while learning our systems and plenty of room to take on more with experience.

Key Responsibilities

Project Setup & Kickoff

  • Set up new projects in Kantata, including tasks, rate cards, and contract items matched to the billing type, so billing and reporting run cleanly from day one.
  • Read contracts and project documents to pull out what matters: billing requirements, payment terms, insurance, retainage, and client-specific rules.
  • Brief the PM and project team at kickoff so everyone knows the client's requirements before work starts.

Billing & Invoicing

  • Prepare monthly billing ahead of each project's deadline, with T&M billing early in the month and Lump Sum billing mid-month.
  • Build Lump Sum invoices from PM-confirmed percent complete, and T&M invoices from verified rates and PM-approved time.
  • Review time entries for accurate notes, tasks, and billable status before anything goes out the door.
  • Monitor project financial health (fees earned versus billed) and flag missing billing or work that needs a change order.
  • Follow up on outstanding invoices and send clients the payment documentation they need to process payment.

Contracts, Change Orders & Compliance

  • Coordinate contract review, flag risk terms for the right people, and track agreements through client execution.
  • Request NET 30 payment terms as our standard position.
  • Track change orders from request through client approval and billing.
  • Process preliminary notices (preliens) and update them as contract value changes.
  • Manage certificates of insurance and workers' compensation documentation to each project's requirements.

PM & Client Support

  • Lead recurring check-ins with PMs on contracts, invoices, and project financials.
  • Send recurring project reports so clients always have a clear view of progress.
  • Request documents and information from clients and outside parties.
  • Coordinate and schedule site visits.
  • Attend project meetings and take clear, complete minutes.

Documentation & Standards

  • Choose the right template for each project document and apply VEC formatting standards.
  • Keep project files organized and current in Google Drive and ClickUp.
  • Protect data accuracy across our project management and financial systems.
  • Be a go-to resource on company protocols, and bring process gaps or recurring issues to your Lead. We genuinely want your ideas for doing things better.

A Month in the Role

  • Early month: T&M billing, the 1st through the 5th.
  • Mid-month: Lump Sum billing, the 15th through the 20th.
  • All month: time entry reviews, change order tracking, AR follow-up, client reports, and project audits that keep your portfolio clean.

Software & Technical Proficiency

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

  • Kantata (formerly Mavenlink) for project setup, billing, and financial tracking, or a comparable project accounting platform.
  • Excel and Google Sheets for tracking, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Word, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace for project documentation and templates.
  • ClickUp and Slack for task tracking and day-to-day team communication.
Who You Are

Required Skills & Experience

  • 1+ years of experience in the construction industry, whether in the office, on a project team, or on site. You know how a job runs and speak the language.
  • Ability to read a contract and spot what matters for billing and compliance. We will teach you what to look for.
  • Comfort juggling multiple projects and deadlines without letting anything slip.
  • Strong skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace.
  • Clear, professional communication with clients, vendors, and teammates by phone, email, and Slack.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ years in project administration, project coordination, or operations administration.
  • Experience with Kantata (Mavenlink) or another project management or project accounting platform, plus tools like ClickUp and Slack.
  • Background in AEC, engineering, or BIM/VDC coordination.
  • Exposure to construction billing, change orders, lien notices, or certificates of insurance.
  • Comfort using AI tools like Claude or Gemini to work smarter, whether that is drafting emails, summarizing contracts, or cleaning up a spreadsheet. You are curious about new ways to save time, and you still double-check the output before it goes anywhere.

Soft Skills Required

  • A sharp eye for detail. You catch the typo, the wrong rate, and the missing signature, and you care about getting it right the first time.
  • Confidence working independently, paired with the habit of keeping your team in the loop.
  • Curiosity to research answers on your own and learn our services well enough to explain them.
  • Integrity and a team-first attitude. You show up for your coworkers and help shape a culture people want to be part of.

Hard Skills Required

  • Working knowledge of project billing, including T&M and Lump Sum invoicing and percent complete.
  • Ability to maintain accurate data across project management and financial systems.
  • Familiarity with construction documentation such as contracts, change orders, certificates of insurance, and preliminary notices.
  • Working proficiency across Kantata, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Slack (see Software & Technical Proficiency above).

VEC is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. In accordance with federal and state laws, VEC does not discriminate in employment because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related condition, ancestry, medical condition (associated with cancer, a history of cancer, or genetic characteristics), veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or gender expression, HIV/AIDS status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law

title: Senior FHIR & Interoperability Test Engineer (Remote Opportunity)

title: Executive Business Administrator
description:
Overview

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud. Within CO&I, the Engineering Procurement & Construction (EPC) organization is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.

As the Executive Business Administrator (EBA) supporting the CVP for the AMERS region within Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I), you will serve as a strategic partner to the Executive Office—driving operational excellence, enabling leadership effectiveness, and fostering a high-performing, inclusive support culture.

This role goes beyond traditional executive support. You will lead and set the tone for a team of Executive Assistants across the AMERS leadership team (LT), building a strong, collaborative, and high-trust culture that ensures seamless support for senior leaders. You will operate with maturity, sound judgment, and a people-first mindset—while holding a high bar for excellence.



Responsibilities

Executive Office Leadership & Culture

  • Lead and develop a team of Executive Assistants supporting the AMERS LT, creating a strong, inclusive, and high-performing team culture.

  • Set clear standards for excellence across the EA community; coach, mentor, and support growth and development.

  • Foster a culture of trust, collaboration, and accountability—ensuring coverage, continuity, and partnership across the LT.

  • Lead with empathy and professionalism; create an environment where EAs and leaders feel supported and set up for success.

Strategic Executive Support & Calendar Leadership

  • Provide proactive, strategic calendar management for the CVP, aligning time to top priorities and business outcomes.

  • Anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and make high-quality decisions in real time.

  • Ensure alignment across the Executive Office, Chief of Staff, Business Managers, and LT to optimize leader effectiveness.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and discretion in all aspects of the role.

Leadership Team (LT) Enablement

  • Partner closely with the Chief of Staff and LT to ensure seamless coordination, strong communication, and consistent execution.

  • Ensure the LT is well-supported with clear logistics, preparedness, and follow-through across meetings, travel, and priorities.

  • Drive consistency and best practices across LT support, reducing friction and improving overall effectiveness.

Rhythm of Business (ROB) & Operational Excellence

  • Drive execution of the AMERS Rhythm of Business in partnership with the Chief of Staff and Business Management team.

  • Ensure meetings are purposeful, well-prepared, and aligned to business priorities.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and reduce administrative burden across the org.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication

  • Build strong partnerships across executive offices, business managers, HR, finance, and central teams.

  • Act as a connector across organizations to drive alignment, share information, and unblock progress.

  • Proactively communicate updates and ensure stakeholders are aligned on priorities and execution.

Event & Offsite Leadership

  • Lead planning and execution of high-impact leadership events (e.g., LT offsites, QBRs, town halls).

  • Design and execute workback plans, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong attendee experience.

  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to deliver seamless end-to-end execution.

Resource & Operations Management

  • Oversee executive office operations, including budgets, expenses, space planning, and vendor coordination.

  • Ensure compliance with policies while optimizing resources to support the business.

  • Support headcount planning and organizational initiatives as needed.

Travel & Logistics

  • Oversee complex, global travel planning for the CVP, ensuring efficient, well-coordinated itineraries.

  • Anticipate risks and proactively manage changes to minimize disruption.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years Administrative, Executive Business Support in an environment with an emphasis on scheduling meetings/events, travel management, and administration work for executive/upper level management.
Other Requirements:
  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience supporting senior executives (VP/CVP level or equivalent), including complex calendar management and executive operations

  • Experience leading or mentoring Executive Assistants or business support teams.

  • Proven ability to build and sustain a positive, high-performing team culture.

  • Proven partnership skills with executive leadership, business managers, and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience supporting large, complex organizations with distributed leadership teams.

  • Experience managing budgets, events, and operational processes at scale.

  • Experience operating in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment with strong prioritization and decision-making skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and handle highly confidential information with discretion.

What Makes You Successful in This Role

  • Executive presence & maturity – Trusted partner who leads through influence and sound judgment.

  • People leadership mindset – Invests in others, builds culture, and raises the bar across the EA community.

  • Respectful leadership + accountability balance – Leads with empathy while driving high standards and outcomes.

  • Operational excellence – Brings structure, clarity, and consistency to a complex environment.

  • Proactive & anticipatory – Spots issues early and acts before they become problems.

  • Connector & collaborator – Builds lasting relationships and esnures alignment across teams.

  • Culture & Values - You model Microsoft’s values of respect, integrity, and accountability, and foster a culture where people feel supported, included, and empowered to do their best work. You bring a growth mindset and a commitment to building an Executive Office that enables both leaders and teams to thrive.

title: Specialist, Reliability (Fly-In Fly-Out)
Data Center IT Operations Manager
description:
Role Summary

This role is responsible for keeping Compass Datacenters’ internal IT environments running once facilities are live and in production. That covers the servers, networking, storage, and security infrastructure that supports our operations—not customer colocation environments.

You’ll manage the team that handles day-to-day administration, monitoring, patching, and incident response across all production sites. When something breaks at 2 AM, your team is the one that gets the call. When we need to plan capacity for the next round of site launches, you’re the one building that plan. This is a hands-on leadership role—you need to be close enough to the technology to make good calls, and experienced enough as a manager to build and run a reliable team.

What You’ll Own

Production Infrastructure Operations

  • Server and compute: Oversee administration of Windows Server, VMware/Nutanix virtualization clusters, and associated storage environments across all production sites.
  • Network operations: Own the health and performance of the production network—switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, and WAN connectivity. Coordinate with the design team on changes and upgrades.
  • Monitoring and alerting: Make sure monitoring tools are configured, thresholds are tuned, and alerts go to the right people. Reduce noise so the team can focus on what matters.
  • Directory and identity services: Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and identity/access management across the environment.
  • Backup and recovery: Own the backup strategy and make sure restores actually work. Run periodic recovery tests—don’t wait for a real disaster to find out.

Security Operations

  • Incident triage: Serve as the escalation point for security alerts from EDR/MDR tools. Make sure threats are investigated, contained, and resolved—not just acknowledged.
  • Patching and vulnerability management: Run the patching cycle across servers, network gear, and endpoints. Track vulnerabilities, prioritize based on actual risk, and close them out on a schedule.
  • Firewall and access control: Ensure firewall rules, WAF configurations, and access policies stay current and hardened. Clean up stale rules regularly.
  • Compliance alignment: Work within established security frameworks (NIST, CIS, or whatever Compass adopts) and support audit and compliance activities as needed.

Planning and Lifecycle Management

  • Capacity planning: Track utilization across compute, storage, and network resources. Forecast needs based on site launch schedules and growth.
  • Lifecycle management: Maintain a hardware and software lifecycle plan. Know what’s approaching end-of-life, what needs to be refreshed, and when.
  • Budget ownership: Own the IT operations budget. Track spend against forecast, manage renewals, and make the case for capital when it’s needed.
  • Site onboarding: Receive new sites from the construction/design team after commissioning. Validate that systems are built to standard and ready for production support.

Team and Vendor Management

  • Direct management: Lead a team of systems and network administrators. Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s, do real performance reviews, and invest in developing your people.
  • On-call and coverage: Build and maintain an on-call rotation that provides 24/7 coverage without burning the team out.
  • Vendor relationships: Manage relationships with hardware, software, and support vendors. Own contract renewals, escalations, and service-level accountability.
  • Incident management: Run the incident response process for major outages. Lead root cause analysis after the fact and make sure corrective actions actually get implemented.

Why us?

Compass is committed to its core convictions and key principles. We look for people who believe there’s a different way to deliver great projects and can easily adapt to change in a quickly growing organization. We strive to create great partnerships with our clients, contractors and supply chain partners through transparent communications, humble and curious collaboration, and a zealous focus on consistent execution of the most important 20%.

Let us learn about you! Apply today.

Compass is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

Compass is committed to an inclusive culture, and we celebrate and value diverse insights and perspectives. To continue to soar on our rocket ship, we need talent from various backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to successfully participate in the job application, and interview process, and in potential roles to perform crucial job functions.

Benefits:

Medical | Dental | Vision | Voluntary | 401K | Unlimited PTO for US based Employees

title: Help Desk Manager
description:
Looking for a workplace that values excellence and simplicity? At Yardstick Technologies, we excel in delivering top-notch solutions while simplifying complex challenges. Yardstick Technologies, founded in 2008, leads IT outsourcing for small and medium businesses in Western Canada. We help businesses make smart technology decisions to further their strategies. Our fixed-fee services include managed IT solutions, cloud computing, Backup and Disaster Recovery, IT strategy, and consulting.   • Ensure staff consistently provide a positive and professional customer experience through phone, email, and ticket interactions.
  • Monitor and hold team members accountable to key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives.
  • Ensure live call answer targets are achieved through effective scheduling, queue monitoring, and workload management.
  • Monitor ticket queues and actively manage ticket aging to ensure timely resolution of customer requests.
  • Track and improve customer response times and service delivery metrics.
  • Conduct regular quality assurance reviews and audits of tickets, customer interactions, and documentation.
  • Identify coaching opportunities and training needs through performance reviews and quality audits.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and development initiatives.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage employee performance and hold team members accountable to expectations and KPIs.

Additional Requirements:

Physical Requirements (include but are not limited to):

Our Employee Perks:

title: Data Center Program Manager

Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Project Manager (DCPM), you will perform troubleshooting for service incidents, manage assigned projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing best practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
