title: Resident Project Representative
description:
EBA Engineering, Inc. (EBA) is looking for an experienced Resident Project Representative (RPR) to join our team for capital improvement projects at the Potomac Water Filtration Plant (WFP). This position will provide full-time, on-site construction observation, documentation, and coordination for the construction, renovation, rehabilitation, and upgrade of facilities and infrastructure at the plant. The ideal candidate will bring extensive construction inspection or management experience, a strong understanding of building and facility systems, and the ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, designers, inspectors, operations personnel, and project stakeholders.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

As a Resident Project Representative, your responsibilities will encompass:

  • Providing full-time field representation during construction activities at the Potomac WFP
  • Monitoring construction progress and contractor compliance with contract drawings, specifications, approved submittals, permits, and applicable industry standards
  • Observing construction and installation of architectural, structural, building envelope, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection, and related building systems
  • Monitoring structural steel, reinforced concrete, masonry, miscellaneous metals, roofing, waterproofing, exterior cladding, interior finishes, and building renovations
  • Observing electrical power distribution, emergency power and generator systems, building automation and controls, and water treatment facility support systems
  • Monitoring the integration of new building systems and equipment with existing operating plant facilities
  • Identifying and documenting deficiencies, nonconforming work, quality concerns, potential contract issues, and differing site conditions
  • Coordinating with inspectors and project staff regarding corrective actions and resolution of field issues
  • Participating in inspections, commissioning activities, equipment startup, performance testing, and facility turnover activities
  • Verifying proper storage, handling, and installation of construction materials and equipment
  • Reviewing contractor submittals for completeness prior to design review
  • Coordinating and documenting Requests for Information (RFIs), field orders, change orders, and contract modifications
  • Tracking project issues, potential claims, differing site conditions, and schedule impacts
  • Reviewing contractor payment applications and providing recommendations regarding completed work
  • Scheduling, organizing, facilitating, and documenting construction progress meetings
  • Coordinating with contractors, designers, plant operations personnel, regulatory agencies, WSSC representatives, and other project stakeholders
  • Preparing meeting agendas, meeting minutes, action item logs, and follow-up documentation
  • Maintaining project records within applicable project management systems, including e-Builder
  • Preparing detailed daily construction reports documenting work performed, contractor staffing, equipment, site conditions, testing activities, delays, disruptions, safety observations, and project progress
  • Maintaining photographic documentation of construction progress, field conditions, and project milestones
  • Monitoring contractor schedule compliance and communicating variances to the Project Manager
  • Reviewing contractor schedules and schedule updates as required
  • Coordinating construction activities with plant operations to minimize disruptions to active water treatment processes
  • Identifying potential conflicts between construction activities and facility operations
  • Communicating observed safety concerns to appropriate WSSC and contractor personnel
  • Supporting project closeout activities, including punch list development, testing documentation, turnover packages, and record drawings

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

To excel in this role, candidates must possess the following qualifications and abilities:

  • 5+ years of construction inspection experience, preferably involving roadway, transportation, or heavy civil infrastructure construction
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, civil engineering, architectural engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered
  • 10+ years of construction inspection, construction management, owner representation, resident engineering, or related construction experience
  • Experience supporting vertical construction, building rehabilitation, industrial facilities, or similar complex construction projects
  • Experience reviewing and interpreting construction drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, change orders, and other contract documents
  • Knowledge of commercial and industrial building construction practices and methods
  • Understanding of architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection, and building envelope systems
  • Ability to identify and document construction deficiencies, nonconforming work, field conditions, and potential contract issues
  • Experience preparing detailed construction reports, meeting documentation, photographic records, and other project documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational, record-keeping, and stakeholder coordination abilities
  • Ability to work independently in an active construction environment while coordinating effectively with contractors and project personnel
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic construction management platforms
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required WSSC security clearances and site access credentials
  • Ability to perform frequent site walks, inspections, and construction monitoring activities within active treatment plant and construction environments
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to walk over rough and uneven terrain and, on occasion, stand for up to 12 hours per day
  • Ability to perform physical tasks associated with field inspection activities, including bending, stooping, kneeling, twisting, grasping, reaching, raising hands above the head, sitting, climbing, and balancing
  • Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions and on varying terrain

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Previous construction inspection, construction management, or resident engineering experience on water or wastewater treatment facility projects
  • Experience working within active industrial, utility, process, or occupied facilities
  • Knowledge of water treatment plant operations and facility constraints
  • Experience with building envelope systems, structural construction, architectural renovations, HVAC systems, electrical distribution systems, plumbing, and fire protection systems
  • Experience with building commissioning, equipment startup, performance testing, and facility turnover
  • Experience reviewing contractor schedules using Primavera P6
  • Experience using e-Builder or similar project management software
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Construction Manager (CCM), Construction Quality Management (CQM), ICC certification, or other relevant professional certifications

If you meet these criteria and are ready to embark on an exciting opportunity, we encourage you to apply and be part of our team!

BENEFITS:

We offer a range of benefits to help you thrive in your career, including a competitive salary and comprehensive compensation package; health benefits encompassing medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage; participation in a wellness rewards program designed to eliminate medical deductibles; a 401(k) plan with matching contributions from the company; flexible spending accounts; company-paid coverage for short- and long-term disability insurance; life insurance benefits; paid holidays and vacation time; as well as reimbursement for tuition, certifications, and licensure to facilitate your ongoing professional advancement.

WHAT WE DO:

At EBA, we appreciate that our success depends upon the experience, knowledge, and teamwork of our staff. As such, we make our commitment count for our employees by valuing you and the work you do. We are committed to supporting diversity, opening doors, trading ideas, encouraging innovation, and giving our staff what they need to perform exceptional work in an exceptional atmosphere.

EBA provides civil/site, geotechnical, structural, transportation, water resources, and water systems engineering; surveying and mapping; construction management/inspection; field and laboratory material testing; subsurface utility engineering; drilling; asset management; and geospatial technologies services to clients throughout the Mid-Atlantic region.

We encourage you to apply and become a valued member of our team.

EBA is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

NOTICE TO THIRD-PARTY AGENCIES:

Please note that EBA does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, EBA will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, EBA explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of EBA.

Must be able to successfully pass a background check. We also conduct pre-employment drug testing. Any job offer will be based on the results of background and drug testing.

title: Especialista em Logística (Logistics Specialist)

title: Estágio de Orçamento
description:

title: Vice President, Finance and IT
description:
For Water Street Mission (WSM) to fulfill its mission and purpose, it is critical for all staff to participate in the development and maintenance of a healthy Christian Community. By living out our faith with one another and creating a space where our guests are invited to experience that community with us, we participate in lives being restored. Even as some positions have minimal direct contact with guests, each staff member has an essential role in forming and maintaining Christian community. The love of Christ, evidenced in our Water Street community, is the real impetus for change with our guests.

Job Summary: Serve in an executive capacity as part of the WSM Leadership Team. Lead the Finance and into growth in quality and effectiveness in its areas of mission, and in relevant objectives in the Strategic Plan. Supervise the ministries of Donor Processing and Finance.

FLSA: Full time, Exempt

All Water Street Mission staff must be:

• Willing to sign the Water Street Mission Statement of Faith

• A current and active member and/or regular attendee of a local church

• Able to fully support the Water Street Mission core values and ministry philosophy

Essential Functions:

Culture and Values

• Share the Good News of Jesus Christ in words and actions with people we serve, communicating hope and dignity

• Walk alongside fellow WSM staff in Christian community as we journey toward maturity

• Encourage restoration in the lives of guests, recognizing we are each restored by God to become restorers

• Work in full coordination with other WSM staff at all times to identify, report and respond appropriately to any potential threats to the safety and wellbeing of guests

• Embody, encourage and cultivate WSM culture, purpose, mission and values in words and actions

Role Specific Responsibilities

• Provide strategic leadership and oversight for all finance, accounting, donor processing, payroll, accounts payable and IT functions

• Partner with the President and Leadership Team to develop organizational strategy, annual budgets, long-range financial plans, and operational initiatives.

• Lead the annual budgeting process and long-range financial planning for the organization.

• Direct all financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and financial analysis to support organizational decision-making.

• Lead the annual financial statement audit, Form 990 preparation, and organizational compliance with GAAP, IRS, ECFA, state regulations, and other applicable requirements.

• Ensure effective internal controls, financial policies, systems, and processes that promote accuracy, accountability, and operational excellence.

• Oversee cash management, investment monitoring, insurance, employee benefits, and organizational risk management.

• Oversee SPE/EITC reporting and compliance processes in collaboration with Advancement and Wonder Academy.

• Provide executive oversight of donor financial operations, including gift processing, bequests, securities, charitable gift annuities, and related financial reporting.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with financial institutions, auditors, consultants, technology partners, and other external stakeholders.

• Establish, monitor, and report key financial and operational performance metrics.

• Foster collaboration across departments to support organizational priorities and ministry objectives.

• Oversee the implementation and maintenance of systems and procedures that will provide timely, accurate, and thorough reports on the overall operating conditions of WSM.

• Recruit, develop, supervise, and evaluate Finance and IT staff while cultivating a Christ-centered, high-performing team culture.

• Serve as a member of the Leadership Team and Operations Leadership Team, representing Finance, Operations and IT in organizational planning and decision-making.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervision

• Directly supervise the Controller, Finance Specialist, Donation Processing Specialist, and Director of IT.

• Provide interim leadership for vacant positions within the division until a permanent replacement is identified.

• Foster the spiritual, professional, and leadership development of departmental staff in partnership with the VP of People and Culture.

• Partner with Leadership in annual performance evaluations, merit recommendations, succession planning, and volunteer engagement.

Education and Experience:

• Four years of financial leadership required.

• Seven years of work in accounting required.

• Experience with non-profit accounting and fiscal audits preferred.

• CPA license is preferred.

• Thorough knowledge of GAAP and ECFA Standards preferred.

• Familiarity with Sage and Bill.com accounting software preferred.

• Experience growing relationships with community partners and representing an organization to the public.

Skills and Attributes:

• Strong evidence of active Christian formation, spiritual maturity and wise leadership.

• Strategic thinker with the ability to align financial and operational decisions with organizational mission and goals.

• Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and team development skills.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze complex financial and operational information.

• Excellent decision-making, problem-solving, and change management skills.

• Ability to build collaborative relationships across departments and with external partners.

• Thorough knowledge of accounting principles (GAAP) and financial reporting.

• Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

• Ability to advise executive leadership and the Board of Directors.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to balance strategic priorities and operational responsibilities.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment in sensitive matters.

• Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

Reports To: Senior Vice President, Operations

Key Internal Relationships: WSM Leadership Team; Operations Leadership Team; VP, People and Culture

Physical Demands:

Occasionally = 1%-33%; Frequently = 34%-66%; Continuously = 67%-100%

The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

• Stand, walk, or sit- Continuously

• Use of fine motor skills- Continuously

• Bend, squat, kneel, and reach- Occasionally

• Lift and/or move up to 50 pounds- Occasionally

• Weekend and evening availability- Occasionally

Christian Life:

Water Street Mission is a privately funded 501(c) 3 non-profit, evangelical Christian ministry. Our designated purpose is religious, and we are a Christ-centered ministry that is dedicated to sharing the Gospel and helping the homeless and impoverished. We consider every position to be essential in the fulfillment of our ministry and purpose statement. As such, each employee must have a relationship with Jesus Christ as their personal Savior and Lord. All employees must:

 Be able and willing to share the Gospel and participate in the ministry activities of Water Street Mission.

 Subscribe to the Water Street Mission Statement of Faith and Qualifications of Employment upon hire and continuously while employed.

 Adhere to the Water Street Mission Employee Handbook.

title: SA River Foundation: Arts & Ecology Admin Intern
description:
We are seeking help with Marketing, Social Media, Events and Administrative Duties all in celebration of our beautiful San Antonio River. The San Antonio River Foundation (SARF) , the non - profit partner to the San Antonio River Authority, is looking for a talented college student to become the newest team member. An ideal candidate is interested in learning about the inspiring and multifaceted world of non - profits and shares our vision of stewardship of the San Antonio River Basin. SARF’s ambitious projects range from creating opportunities for education, recreation, and interaction with nature along the river ; to initiating, funding, installing, and maintaining exciting urban art projects by renowned regional, national, and international artists. • Design eye - catching visuals using Canva to communicate ideas effectively.

• Use your organizational skills to manage tasks and projects in Art, Ecology, Education & Recreation

• Write professional and compelling newsletters to various stakeholders.

• Provide excellent phone support by answering calls with clarity and professionalism.

• Take initiative in identifying challenges and crafting your own solutions.

• Educate the public about environmental stewardship

• Represent San Antonio River Foundation at public events such as Yoga, Farmer’s Markets, Movie Festivals


What We’re Looking For:

• Applicant must be available at least one evening weekend day each week for program support on site at Confluence Park.

• A self - starter who thrives in an independent work environment.

• Someone with strong problem - solving skills and a knack for creative thinking.

• Experience using Canva is required; familiarity with Microsoft Suite, Notion and video editing is a plus.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

• A proactive team member who can manage time effectively and doesn’t need constant direction.


How to Apply: Before applying, please take a moment to visit our website and Instagram page to learn more about our mission and determine if it aligns with your passions and goals. Our website is .


As a San Antonio River Foundation intern, you will gain experience that will allow you to have a lifelong impact in:


• Development: Gain experience in donor management, including fundraising, crafting donor appeals, communication, and managing finances through the Bloomerang (CRM) platform. Conduct research on potential donors, strategic partners, markets, and industries. Prepare reports and presentations. Assist with mailing. Filing and special projects as needed. Review event materials and marketing efforts. Send thank you letters, receipts, and other donor notes.


• Communication, Marketing & Social Media: Assist staff with promoting events. Assist staff with tracking, formatting and archiving messages, reviews, and other media. Maintain and update the San Antonio River Foundation media sites. Assist in the production of advertisements, press releases, and p romotional materials using Canva and the Adobe Suite. Assist with event planning and management. Learn how to operate a DSLR camera and take photos of programs to share on social media.

• Education: (including volunteerism) Assist with tours, school field trips and free community programs including the outdoor cinema series, festivals, and workshops. Attend and help with volunteer events such as river cleanups, habitat restoration, and invasive species removals.

See the importance brand and mission awareness play in non - profit success. Help with strategic planning for upcoming fall giving campaigns such as Big Give and Annual Appeal.


• Event Facilitator and Reservations: Be onsite for art & culture events and/or rental of Confluence Park. Learn to organize, advance, facilitate and follow up after events to create partnerships and connections of art and science organizations throughout San Antonio.


Technology you will gain experience in:

• Bloomerang (CRM management platform)

• Microsoft 365 , Outlook, Teams, Word, PPT, Excel, SharePoint

• Harvest (Time management tool)

• Canva

• Notion

• Adobe Suite


On behalf of the San Antonio River Foundation, we thank you for taking the time to look over our job opportunity. We can’t wait to hear from you! The San Antonio River Foundation Team

title: Memory Care Director
description:
Position: Memory Care Director

Pay Range: $55,000-$67,000

INSERT COMMUNITY NAME is a premier senior living community situated on a beautifully landscaped campus. Managed by Oakmont Management Group, we provide exceptional quality, comfort, and care with five-star services and amenities. Residents enjoy a rewarding lifestyle with individualized comprehensive support that promotes continuing independence. We deliver meaningful lifestyles and relationships with residents, families, and team members by developing a winning culture and living these values: Authenticity * Teamwork * Compassion * Commitment * Resilience.

With communities across California, Colorado, Hawaii, and Nevada, opportunities for career growth, relocation, and travel are significant. In addition, eligible team members may enjoy the following benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • Vacation, Personal Day, Sick Pay, Holidays
  • Complimentary Meals
  • Bonus Opportunities
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Team Member Discount Program (LifeMart)
  • 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match
  • Recognition Programs
  • Student Loan Refinancing
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Emergency Financial Assistance

The Memory Care Director at Oakmont leads a ‘Whole living’ approach to dementia care in their community, which is the philosophy of partnering with the resident to care ‘with them’ rather than ‘for them in order to encourage each resident to reach their highest potential physically, cognitively, socially, emotionally and spiritually, ensuring maximized independence by creating an engaging and dignified environment that enhances the residents’ ability to be themselves and live their most fulfilling life.

The Memory Care Director is responsible for general oversight of all aspects of the Traditions (Memory Care) neighborhood in their community, ensuring that the delivery of dementia care services including the delivery of care, delivery of activities, and delivery of culinary, exceed the resident and family expectations and meet the required services outlined in the residents’ service plan. The memory care director offers dementia expertise and dementia care resources in collaboration with community leaders in culinary, activities, and health services to develop and execute a personalized care plan to best maintain the overall health and well-being of the residents.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintains a safe and secure environment for all team members, residents, and guests, following established safety standards.
  • Understands and ensures compliance with all state (Title 22) regulations concerning the memory care department.
  • Maintains recruiting of all memory care positions. Conducts interviews, hires, onboards, trains, motivates, and retains team members.
  • Coordinates departmental schedule to ensure adequate staffing in accordance with company standards, policies and procedures, and the needs of the residents.
  • Communicates effectively and displays tact and friendliness when dealing with residents, families, visitors, co-workers, and supervisors.
  • Supports resident participation in activities. Ensures an engaging and dynamic activities program is executed daily.
  • Supports resident participation in dining and collaborates with the Culinary team to ensure resident nutrition needs are met and the quality of the culinary experience remains positive.
  • Provides input to Health Services Director regarding Memory Care resident pre-admission assessments and reassessments.
  • Assists the Health Services Director in coordinating incidental medical, dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care for residents and arrange resident escorts as needed.
  • Partners with community healthcare professionals, including physicians, discharge planners, nurses, and state agencies on the care needs of residents as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen (18) years of age
  • Prefer two (2) years of experience working with persons with dementia
  • Prefer one (1) year of experience supervising and managing employees
  • Preferred BA/S in Gerontology, psychology, sociology, or related field or at least 3 years working in social services, residential care, psychiatric facility, or related setting.
  • A Residential Care Facility for the Elderly administrators’ license may be required.
  • Hold or able to obtain one or more certifications related to Dementia care; such as Certified Dementia Practitioner (CDP), Certified Alzheimer’s Caregiver (CAC), Certified Alzheimer’s Educator (CAE), Certified Dementia Care Manager (CDCM), Certified Montessori Dementia Care Professional and/or other equivalents.
  • Able to obtain and maintain valid first aid and CPR certification
  • Able to obtain and maintain a valid Food Handler’s certification
  • Must pass a Criminal Background check and Health Screening tests, including physical and TB Tests.
  • For the health and safety of our team members and residents, Oakmont Management Group may require team members to vaccinate, participate in daily screening, surveillance testing, and to wear face coverings and other personal protective equipment (PPE) to prevent the spread of the COVID-19 or other communicable diseases, per regulatory guidelines.

Oakmont Management Group, based in Irvine, California, is a recognized leader in the senior living industry that manages a portfolio of communities under the Oakmont Senior Living and Ivy Living brands. OMG serves thousands of seniors across communities in California, Nevada, and Hawaii. title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Under limited supervision, the Data Governance Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, integrity, governance, and usability of enterprise data assets supporting data quality, governance execution, issue management, reporting readiness, and usability of commercial enterprise data assets across key business systems (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, reporting platforms). This role partners cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, IT, and other business functions to support data standards, coordinate governance processes, and support high-quality analytics and decision-making.

The Data Governance Analyst plays a critical role in maintaining trusted, auditable data aligned with MEUS-IAD’s operational, financial, and compliance requirements. The role facilitates data quality monitoring, root cause analysis, remediation coordination, KPI reporting, and governance documentation to improve confidence in commercial reporting and business processes.

POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential Functions

Data Governance & Standards

• Support the development, documentation, and maintenance of data standards, definitions, and business rules across assigned data domains (e.g., customers, opportunities, pricing, incentives).

• Partner with business stakeholders to ensure consistent interpretation and usage of key data elements.

• Facilitate alignment between business owners, data users, and technical teams regarding data definitions, ownership, and governance expectations.

Data Quality Management

• Monitor data quality using defined metrics (completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency).

• Perform data profiling and trend analysis to identify quality risks, anomalies, and process improvement opportunities.

• Identify data issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation actions. Maintain and prioritize a data quality issue backlog.

• Coordinate remediation activities across business and technical teams and track corrective actions through closure.

• Establish and maintain data quality dashboards and reporting. Define, monitor, and report data quality KPIs, thresholds, and scorecards.

Data Stewardship Execution

• Data Governance Execution & Change Coordination

• Coordinate review and approval processes for critical data changes in core systems (e.g., account hierarchy updates, pricing records, master data updates).

• Support workflows for data creation, updates, and governance approvals.

• Document recurring issues, root causes, and recommended corrective or preventive actions.

Requirements & Business Process Analysis

• Gather, document, and validate business requirements related to data management, reporting, and governance initiatives.

• Translate business requirements into data standards, controls, process improvements, and system enhancement recommendations.

• Partner with business and IT teams to support implementation of approved solutions.

Change Impact Assessment

• Evaluate downstream impacts of business process, organizational, and system changes on data quality, reporting, and governance controls.

• Support projects and system enhancements by ensuring data governance requirements are incorporated early in design.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as a liaison between business users, IT, and system administrators to resolve data-related issues.

• Support initiatives involving CRM, ERP, and analytics platforms by ensuring data readiness and alignment.

• Present data quality trends, findings, and recommendations to business stakeholders as needed.

Process Documentation & Controls

• Create and maintain documentation for data processes, governance policies, and standard operating procedures.

• Ensure alignment with internal controls, audit requirements, and compliance standards.

• Support development and maintenance of governance policies, standards, and decision frameworks.

Reporting & Analytics Support

• Partner with analytics teams to ensure data models and reports leverage standardized, reliable data sources.

• Guide proper data usage for reporting and dashboards.

• Analyze the business impact of data quality issues on reporting, forecasting, customer management, and operational processes.

Governance Program Support

• Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data governance initiatives.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making regarding data quality and governance priorities.

• Support communication and adoption of governance standards across impacted business teams.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve data quality, streamline processes, and enhance governance frameworks.

• Support implementation of data governance tools, automation, and workflows.

• Develop data-driven recommendations to improve consistency, accuracy, and process reliability.

Additional Responsibilities

• May be required to follow other job-related instructions and perform additional duties as assigned.

Travel Requirements

• Minimal travel required (typically <10% domestic), depending on business needs.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Essential:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5+ years experience in data governance, data management, data quality, business systems, or related commercial operations role (e.g., CRM, ERP)

• Experience working with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP, or similar platforms

• Experience performing data profiling, root cause analysis, issue prioritization, and remediation coordination

• Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into data standards, controls, reporting needs, and process improvements

• Knowledge of reporting and analytics concepts, including KPI definitions, scorecards, and dashboard usage

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to translate technical concepts to business users

• Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Beneficial:

• Experience with data governance tools (e.g., data catalog, data quality platforms)

• Knowledge of reporting platforms (e.g., CRM Analytics, Tableau, Power BI)

• Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts

• Experience supporting SOX controls or audit processes

• Background in manufacturing, sales operations, or financial data domains

title: Director, R&D - Formulation
description:
Leads formulation-driven R&D activities across priority business platforms, ensuring development of commercially viable products that meet customer, regulatory, operational, sensory, nutritional, and financial expectations. Responsible for translating customer briefs and business priorities into optimized, scalable formulations while driving innovation, cost competitiveness, IP development and protection, and monetization of the opportunity pipeline. This role leads the formulation organization with a clear focus on speed-to-market, first-round sample acceptance (making it to the second round and/or hitting customer expectations), commercialization success, and organic growth through new product development, applications development, benchtop sessions, standard samples, and formulation cost-out. While formulation is the primary focus, this role and the team also provide process design, process validation, scale-up support, plant trial leadership, and troubleshooting expertise when required to ensure products can be successfully manufactured at commercial scale.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Formulation Development & Execution:

  • Lead formulation development from concept through pilot plant readiness across dairy beverages, cultured systems, sauces, cheese, dry blends, concentrates, flavors, specialty co-drying, and other priority platforms
  • Translate customer briefs, business objectives, and consumer needs into executable formulation plans with clear success criteria, timelines, risks, and decision points
  • Own ingredient selection, supplier qualification input, benchtop development, iterative prototyping, formula optimization, nutritional targets, and application validation
  • Use sensory science, analytical data (from R&D work and plants), and customer end-use testing to ensure products meet or exceed expectations for taste, functionality, nutrition, processing performance, and shelf-life
  • Drive disciplined documentation in R&D modeling solutions, including formula version control, development notes, learnings, specifications, sample history, and commercialization readiness inputs
  • Define and validate critical product and process requirements, including processing conditions, ingredient addition sequence, hydration, shear, heat treatment, hold times, cooling, packaging considerations, and other parameters needed to translate bench formulations into repeatable manufacturing processes.

Commercialization Readiness & Pipeline Monetization:

  • Monetize the opportunity and innovation pipeline by prioritizing formulation work that supports growth, margin, strategic customer needs, and ROI expectations
  • Drive formulation support for priority commercialization programs, ensuring samples are internally validated before customer submission and ready for scale-up handoff
  • Partner with Processing Design & Validation, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and Commercialization to reduce risk from bench to pilot plant to full-scale production
  • Lead or support process design and validation work when formulation decisions directly affect equipment capability, processing windows, yield, product stability, food safety, quality attributes, throughput, or commercial feasibility
  • Improve speed-to-market, sample turnaround time, first-round acceptance (making it to the second round and/or hitting customer expectations), scale-up success, and customer conversion through disciplined development plans and decision-making
  • Partner with plants and technical resources to design trials, establish run conditions, evaluate process performance, document learnings, and confirm that the final formula-process combination is ready for repeatable commercialization
  • Use CRM/Salesforce and R&D metrics to manage opportunity status, project milestones, sample activity, pipeline health, and leadership reporting.

Cost, Margin & Formula Optimization:

  • Lead formula cost modeling, least-cost formulation, and flexible formulation strategies that account for commodity volatility, raw material availability, customer requirements, and supply chain realities
  • Deliver margin improvement through ingredient optimization, reformulation, cost-out, and value engineering while protecting product performance and customer acceptance
  • Build formulation approaches that allow for ingredient substitution, raw material flexibility, and supply continuity without compromising quality, safety, or label expectations
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, and Commercial teams to ensure development decisions are connected to COGS, pricing effectiveness, profitability, and business case expectations

Innovation, Capability Development & IP:

  • Drive formulation-based innovation in protein fortification, stabilization and emulsification, fermentation and flavor development, natural emulsification, fat utilization, dairy powders, concentrates, sauces, permeate, cultured products, specialty co-drying, and other new aspects of food science
  • Expand DFA’s technical capabilities by identifying new ingredients, technologies, methods, and formulation approaches that create differentiated customer solutions and switching barriers
  • Partner with engineering, process technology, operations, and Sr. Principal Scientists to connect advanced discovery with scalable formulation and commercialization pathways
  • Contribute technical leadership to process design and validation for new or complex product platforms, particularly where formulation functionality, process capability, equipment design, and commercialization risk are highly interdependent
  • Identify, develop, document, and protect intellectual property where formulation, ingredient systems, applications, or process/formula combinations create unique value.

Customer, Commercial & Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Lead technical engagement with customers through benchtop sessions, ideation meetings, demos, sample reviews, troubleshooting, plant trials, and post-launch support
  • Support Sales, Marketing, Innovation, and business leaders by translating customer strategies, brand needs, and category priorities into commercially relevant formulation solutions
  • Influence cross-functional partners to “solve for yes” while maintaining food safety, regulatory, quality, operational, and financial discipline
  • Contribute technical content and review customer-facing presentations, sell sheets, technical briefs, and commercialization materials for accuracy and impact

Team Leadership & Talent Development:

  • Lead and develop a formulation team that may include Principal Scientists, Sr. Scientists, Scientists, Associate Scientists, and other technical resources assigned to formulation-related work
  • Build technical depth and breadth across wet and dry dairy systems, applications, cost-out, customer support, and commercialization readiness
  • Ensure the team maintains practical capability in process design, process validation, plant trial execution, troubleshooting, and scale-up support so formulation work remains connected to operational reality
  • Establish development plans, coaching routines, technical standards, and learning opportunities that strengthen bench strength and career progression
  • Create a culture of accountability, speed, monetization, customer focus, and “do what it takes to win” while reinforcing a “never stop learning” mindset

The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required.

title: RM Agribusiness Fishing & Aquaculture Specialist
description:
1. 0 ABOUT EQUITY BANK TANZANIA

Equity Bank Tanzania Limited is a subsidiary Of Equity Group Holdings PLC, a Pan-African Financial Services Group with operations in six countries namely Kenya, Rwanda, ORC, Uganda, Tanzania, and South Sudan. The Group also has ambition to grow its footprint to a further six countries by 2030. The scope of the business cuts across Banking, Insurance, Technology, and Social Enterprise. Our business model is underpinned by Social, Economic and Sustainability engines (Tri-Engine Model) that capacitate value chains sustainably and support communities.

2.0 THE ROLE PURPOSE

The RM Agribusiness Cage Fishing & Aquaculture Specialist will be responsible for developing, managing, and growing Equity Bank Tanzania's commercial portfolio within the fisheries, Cage fishing, aquaculture, and associated aquatic value chains. The role will provide specialized relationship management and technical support to fish farmers, cage-farming enterprises, hatcheries, feed suppliers, fish aggregators, processors, traders, cold-chain operators, equipment suppliers, cooperatives, off- takers, and other fisheries and aquaculture value chain actors. The role holder will identity, originate, structure, and manage quality financing opportunities across the aquaculture and fisheries ecosystem, while growing loans, deposits, transaction banking, and Other financial products. The role will support Customers to improve production efficiency, productivity, profitability, market access, and financial sustainability. The RM will serve as a technical and Commercial resource on aquaculture and cage- farming value chains, with particular emphasis on production cycles, stocking densities, fingerling quality, feed management, fish health, cage infrastructure, water quality, harvesting, processing, market dynamics, and associated business and environmental risks. The position will contribute to financial inclusion and sustainable blue-economy development by linking fish farmers and fisheries enterprises to financial services, markets, technology, technical expertise, and strategic ecosystem partners.

3.0 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Aquaculture & Fisheries Relationship Management Develop and manage strategic relationships with fish farmers, cage-farming enterprises, hatcheries, fishing enterprises, cooperatives, aggregators, processors, traders, feed suppliers, equipment providers, and off-takers. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of quality aquaculture, fisheries, and related agribusiness customers. Conduct customer visits, farm/site visits, cage-farm assessments, business reviews, and value chain assessments. Understanc* customers' production models, operating cycles, cash flows, financing needs, market arrangements, and growth opportunities. Develop and implement customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio deepening strategies. Identify opportunities to cross-sell loans, deposits, insurance, payments, digital banking, and other relevant financial solutions. Act as the primary relationship contact for assigned customers and coordinate resolution of customer issues with internal teams. Cage Fishing & Aquaculture Value Chain Development Develop strong technical and commercial knowledge Of cage aquaculture and fisheries value chains, including tilapia and other commercially viable fish species. Map aquaculture value chains to identify commercially viable financing opportunities, gaps, risks, and opportunities for value addition. Identify strategic anchor enterprises, hatcheries, feed manufacturers, equipment suppliers, processors, aggregators, distributors, and Off-takers. Facilitate linkages between fish farmers, fingerling suppliers, feed suppliers, equipment providers, processors, markets, and financial service providers. Support development of structured aquaculture financing models based on production cycles, stocking, feed requirements, growth periods, harvesting schedules, and market arrangements. Identify opportunities for financing cage construction, fish farming equipment, boats, cold storage, transport, processing, feed, fingerlings, working capital, and other productive assets. Monitor fish prices, feed costs, fingerling availability, market demand, disease risks, water quality, weather patterns, regulatory developments, and other factors affecting the portfolio. Identify opportunities for value addition, fish processing, cold-chain development, packaging, distribution, and market expansion. Technical Aquaculture & production Support Provide technical gui dance on commercially viable aquaculture and cage-farming business modals. • Support customers to improve fish survival rates, growth rates, feed conversion, stocking management, harvesting efficiency, and profitability. Promote good practices in fingerling selection, stocking density, feed management, water-quality monitoring, fish health, cage maintenance, biosecurity, harvesting, handling, and post-harvest management. Support adoption Of climate-smart and environmentally sustainable aquaculture practices. Coordinate with fisheries Officers, aquaculture specialists, veterinarians, research institutions, and other qualified technical partners where specialized support is required. Promote proper production, financial, and farm records to strengthen business management and customer bankability. • Support customers to understand the relationship between production performance, cash flows, profitability, and financing requirements. Credit & Portfolio Management • Originate quality aquaculture, fisheries, and related agribusiness loan applications in accordance with the Bank'S credit policies. • Conduct preliminary assessment of customer financial performance, production systems, cash flows, repayment capacity, collateral, assets, market arrangements, and production risks. Assess financing requirements including cage construction, boats, engines, nets, feeding equipment, aeration equipment, cold storage, fish processing equipment, fingerlings, feed, working capital, and transport. prepare high-quality credit proposals and Supporting documentation for consideration through the Bank's credit approval processes. Assess the technical and commercial viability Of aquaculture and fisheries enterprises before financing. Monitor financed customers and portfolios to identify emerging production, market, environmental, and financial risks. Monitor Portfolio at Risk (PAR) and proactively initiate remedial actions for stressed accounts. Conduct periodic site visits and business reviews to assess production performance, utilization of financing, assets, inventory, and repayment capacity. Ensure compliance with credit policies, KYC, AML, environmental and social safeguards, fisheries regulations, and all applicable Bank policies and regulations. Work closely with Credit, Risk, Collections, Legal, Operations, and other relevant functions to manage portfolio risks. Deposit & Transaction Banking Growth Mobilize deposits from fish farmers, aquaculture companies, fishing enterprises, cooperatives, processors, traders, feed companies, and other value chain actors. Promote digital payment and transaction banking solutions across fisheries and aquaculture value chains. Facilitate efficient collection and payment mechanisms between farmers, aggregators, processors, suppliers, and Off-takers. Identify opportunities to increase Customer wallet share through relevant banking products. Promote formal financial services among small-scale fish farmers and fisheries enterprises. Farmer & Customer Capacity Development Organize fish farmer and aquaculture enterprise sensitization forums on financial literacy, banking products, responsible borrowing, and financial management. Support customers to prepare business plans, financial records, cash-flow projections, investment plans, and financing proposals. For Internal use Only Facilitate awareness and training on good aquaculture practices, fish health, feed management, water quality, cage management, biosecurity. post-harvest handling, and market requirements. Support farmer groups and cooperatives to strengthen governance, record keeping, financial management, and commercial operations. Promote responsible use Of agricultural finance and strengthen customers' abiüty to manage financing and repayment obligations. Partnerships & Ecosystem Development Identify and develop strategic partnerships with government fisheries and aquaculture authorities, development partners, NGOs, research institutions, hatcheries, feed manufacturers, equipment suppliers, processors, off-takers, and industry associations. Develop relationships with fisheries and aquaculture cooperatives and other producer organizations. Support development Of blended finance, guarantee, grant, and risk-sharing facilities that can unlock financing for fisheries and aquaculture. Participate in fisheries and aquaculture exhibitions, field days, trade fairs, farmer forums, and stakeholder meetings representing Equity Bank Tanzania. Maintain an updated database of strategic fisheries and aquaculture stakeholders and commercial opportunities. Data, Monitoring& Reporting Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer, pipeline, portfolio, and value chain information in approved Bank systems. Track performance against targets for aquaculture and fisheries loans, deposits, customer acquisition, portfolio quality, transaction volumes, and Customer reach. Prepare accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports covering commercial performance, pipeline development, portfolio quality, customer activities, risks, and opportunities. Analyse aquaculture and fisheries market data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Collaborate with Monitoring & Evaluation and other relevant teams to collect and validate Commercial and program performance data. Undertake any other business activities as required by organizational needs.

4.0 CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

Growth in aquaculture, cage-farming, fisheries, and related agribusiness loans and advances. Growth in deposits and transaction banking revenues from fisheries and aquaculture customers. Quality and value of the aquaculture and fisheries financing pipeline. Achievement df agreed disbursement and portfolio growth targets. Maintenance Of acceptable PAR and non-performing Loan levels. Growth in number and value of active aquaculture and fisheries customers. Growth in fish farmer, cooperative, processor, aggregator, trader, and off-taker accounts. Number and value ot strategic aquaculture and fisheries partnerships developed. Number and value Of blended finance, guarantee, grant, or risk-sharing opportunities supported. Number Of fish farmers and value chain actors reached, onboarded, and activated.

title: Buyer/Planner
description:

title: Quality Inspection Technician
description:

title: Planner II
description:
Position Purpose

Coordinates the purchase and availability of raw materials, components, finished parts, supplies, and services while translating OEM customer order requirements into executable production priorities. Serves as a primary contact for OEM customer order activity, works with production scheduling to maintain alignment with frequently changing customer demand, and manages license plating activities and corrections that affect order processing and shipment execution.

Essential Functions

  • Review customer orders, requisitions, specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and changing demand signals; communicate relevant changes to production scheduling and affected departments.
  • Work directly with production scheduling to maintain alignment between the manufacturing schedule, material availability, capacity considerations, and current OEM customer requirements.
  • Serve as a primary customer service contact for assigned OEM customer orders, providing timely coordination and issue communication to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage license plating activities, monitor transaction accuracy, research discrepancies, and coordinate required corrections to support accurate order processing and shipment activity.
  • Identify and analyze raw-material and component requirements using MRP, JIT, KANBAN, customer demand, and production schedules.
  • Prepare and release purchase orders; perform follow-up, expediting, and supplier coordination necessary to support production and service requirements.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels while balancing customer order fulfillment, freight expense, inventory carrying cost, lot sizes, delivery frequency, and timing.
  • Prepare RFQs and negotiate pricing, contracts, delivery requirements, and commercial issues with suppliers within assigned responsibility.
  • Maintain positive supplier relationships and evaluate supplier quality, on-time delivery, service performance, and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate replacement of nonconforming material, return of surplus material, canceled orders, and other supplier adjustments.
  • Support engineering changes, new-part releases, part transitions, revision changes, and PPAP-related communication with suppliers and internal departments.
  • Communicate customer-order, material, supplier, schedule, and shipment risks to Customer Service, Production, Shipping, Purchasing, Engineering, and other affected functions.
  • Identify and support cost-reduction, inventory-reduction, supplier-performance, ERP, and process-improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain required records and system data for assigned customers, suppliers, parts, purchase orders, schedules, and license plating transactions.
  • Prepare activity, inventory, customer-order, supplier-performance, and other reports as required.
  • Support departmental escalation, cross-training, knowledge transfer, and continuity of critical processes.
  • Utilize QAD, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and other approved business systems.
  • Backup for other positions in the department as needed.
  • Maintain regular attendance and perform other duties as assigned.

Key Working Relationships

  • OEM customers and customer service contacts for assigned order activity.
  • Production Scheduling and Production Operations for schedule and priority alignment.
  • Shipping and Logistics for order readiness, license plating accuracy, and shipment execution.
  • Suppliers for material availability, quality, delivery, pricing, and issue resolution.
  • Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and other Hendrickson departments as required.

Education and Training

  • Associate degree in Materials Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Equivalent relevant manufacturing planning, purchasing, scheduling, or customer-order experience may be considered in accordance with company policy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience in materials planning, purchasing, production scheduling, customer order management, or a related manufacturing function preferred.
  • Working knowledge of MRP, JIT, KANBAN, FIFO, supply-versus-demand analysis, manufacturing operations, and capacity considerations.
  • Ability to interpret changing customer requirements and coordinate schedule, material, and shipment responses across functions.
  • Effective written and verbal communication, negotiation, supplier-management, customer-service, and problem-solving skills.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize and independently execute multiple responsibilities in a changing manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with QAD or a comparable ERP system and Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

title: Steward - On Call
description:

Hotel Kabuki seeks an experienced Steward to join our growing team. A Steward is responsible for washing dishes and kitchen equipment, maintaining cleanliness and sanitation standards, removing waste and trash in accordance with local requirements and Kabuki’s sustainability guidelines, restocking and organizing supplies, assisting with breakfast service, preparing banquet equipment, assisting with “plate-ups” during banquet events, running food to and from event spaces, and assisting with basic kitchen tasks. The role may require standing for extended periods, frequent walking, bending, lifting, pushing, pulling, and reaching.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

Assists with breakfast service and banquet events by gathering and setting up equipment, running food, and clearing dirty dishware and equipment from foodservice spaces.

Gathers all dirty dishware from kitchen and event spaces, rinses and stacks in dishracks, always clearing dishes of leftovers and trash in order to prepare for automated washing.

Loads full dishracks and ensures correct placement in accordance to the instructions for the operation of the machine. Operates automatic dish washing machine by using controls as instructed.

Loads dishwashing solutions into automatic dispensers and regulates the output of detergents and chemicals to the dishwashing machine by monitoring and adjusting controls.

Unloads clean dishes from racks after being processed through dish machine, inspects for cleanliness, and carefully stacks in specified areas for the easy use by restaurant and kitchen staff.

Manually scrubs pots, pans and other kitchen equipment that cannot be washed automatically, using detergents, scourers, and special solutions as required. Inspects for cleanliness, air-dries according to food safety requirements, and puts away in correct places.

Manually polishes all silver, stainless steel and pewter used in food service, using standard polishing cloth and products, in order to present clean and attractive equipment to diners.

Maintains the automatic dishwashing equipment in good condition and working order in accordance with manufacturers' instructions in order to prolong the life of the equipment, prevent breakdowns and to meet mandated health compliance regulations.

Keeps the dishroom in clean and orderly condition at all times by sweeping, mopping, emptying trash, wiping counters and equipment and organizing shelves in order to maintain a sanitary work station and to meet mandated health compliance requirements.

title: Residential Women’s Coordinator and Supervisor
description:
The Women's Coordinator provides both participant-focused services and operational leadership within the residential treatment program. In addition to coordinating specialized programming and support services for pregnant and parenting women, this position provides direct supervision of Recovery Support Staff and helps ensure the delivery of high-quality, trauma-informed, gender-responsive residential services consistent with ASAM 3.5 and SAMHSA PPW program requirements.



  • Coordinate women's programming and services within the residential treatment setting.
  • Collaborate with clinical, medical, recovery support, and residential staff to ensure coordinated care.
  • Assist with implementation of PPW grant activities and program initiatives.
    • Ensure staff maintain a safe, structured, trauma-informed, and recovery-oriented residential environment.
    • Monitor daily program operations and provide oversight to ensure consistent implementation of program policies, procedures, and participant expectations.
    • Support staff in effectively responding to participant needs, crises, behavioral concerns, and conflict resolution.
    • Facilitate staff meetings, shift communication, and coordination between residential and clinical teams.
    • Ensure appropriate supervision and support of participants during daily activities, parenting responsibilities, transportation, appointments, and community outings.
    • Promote a culture of participant engagement, dignity, respect, accountability, and wellness throughout the residential program.
    • Serve as a leadership presence within the residential environment and provide on-call support as assigned.
    • Coordinate and/or facilitate educational groups, workshops, and activities that support recovery and relapse prevention, women's health, parenting skills, and healthy relationships.
    • Assist in creating a safe, supportive, and recovery-focused residential environment.
    • Ability to build collaborative relationships with participants, families, and community partners.
    • Monitors staff performance and provides the resources/staff development necessary to reach program goals.
    • Promote participant engagement, retention, and successful completion of treatment services.
    • Provide individualized support, coaching, encouragement, and advocacy.
    • Serve as a consistent point of contact for participants and assist in navigating program expectations.
    • Support participants in identifying strengths, setting goals, and building recovery capital.
    • Reviews program financial statements, monitoring revenue and expenses while collaborating with supervisory and administrative staff in moving toward program self-sufficiency.
    • Has an awareness of maintenance needs and communicates or coordinates with maintenance staff to resolve them.



      Minimum Requirements

      • Bachelor's degree in social work, Human Services, Psychology, Counseling, Family Studies, Public Health, or related
        field.
      • Minimum of two years of experience working with women, families, individuals with behavioral health, substance use, or social service needs.
      • Knowledge of trauma-informed and gender-responsive services.
      • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills.
      • Experience leading or supervising direct care, residential, or recovery support staff.

title: Graphics Coordinator, TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle
description:
The Graphics Coordinator at TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle is the primary graphics contact for producers, directors, artists and playback operators. The Coordinator reviews and modifies graphic orders, assigns uncompleted requests, and produces additional elements to enhance segments. The Coordinator serves as the final evaluator of prepared graphics, ensuring elements are accurate, error-free, and made in accordance with the producers’ visions and the show’s look and feel. The Coordinator plays an integral role in the control room, alerting the director when elements should be inserted and producing last-minute requests.

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

  • Manage graphics from conception to completion, including animations, monitors, photographs, text panels and lower thirds
  • Review, proof and assign existing graphics requests, generate additional elements to enhance stories
  • Load and traffic all elements into the daily rundown for playback.
  • Compose a daily list of supers and transfer the information to lower third graphics

  • 1+ years of experience in production at the network or daytime television level
  • 1+ years of experience working with graphics at the network or cable news level
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communication, English or a related field of study

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in fast-paced environment
  • Strong grammar, punctuation, spelling and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge and interest in pop culture and current events

  • Strong journalistic research skills and editorial judgment

title: System Failure Analysis Engineer
description: Meta is seeking a System Failure Analysis Engineer to join our Hardware Quality and Reliability Engineering team, focusing on Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) and Ongoing Field Failure Analysis (OFFA) for consumer hardware products including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. title: Senior Financial Data Analyst
description:
About The Team

The FinOps Analytics team, central to Uber's Financial Operations, provides crucial insights across Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Travel & Expense (T&E), and Order-to-Cash (OTC). We partner with Fintech to develop data transformations and publish over 80 Tableau Dashboards. Our work drives strategic metrics, scales operations, and improves working capital and free cash flow through targeted ad-hoc analysis.

About The Role

We are currently looking for a stellar Senior Financial Data Analyst to join Uber!

Our team is responsible for delivering critical information and analyses that drive strategic decisions within Uber Financial Operations. We equip ‌our partners and their stakeholders with timely, accurate, and actionable insights to achieve their objectives. Simply put, while FinOps manages the engine of Finance's operational transactions, FinOps Analytics provides the compass - leveraging Tableau dashboards and analysis to chart our course. We are actively seeking to strengthen our expertise in machine learning and predictive analytics, and that's where your skills become essential.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Own the full lifecycle of operational metrics-from KPI design to dashboard deployment and stakeholder adoption to design metrics that drive accountability, surface inefficiencies, and guide automation
  • Utilize predictive modeling techniques to support scenario analysis, helping the FinOps team to understand potential financial outcomes based on various business strategies
  • Perform ad hoc analyses and create reports as requested by leadership to support strategic initiatives and decision-making
  • Drive automation efforts for reporting, leveraging data science tools to increase efficiency and accuracy

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of work experience in finance analytics, business analytics, data analytics and or within a similar field
  • Experience with Tableau and or similar data visualization tools
  • Experience with SQL
  • Bachelors Degree or equivalent FinOps experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making
  • 3+ years of demonstrable experience in data science, financial analytics, or a similar role with a focus on financial data
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Curious, self-directed, and impact-driven - you chase high-impact problems to deliver solutions.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and switching contexts in a fast-moving environment

For Dallas, TX-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $118,000 per year - USD $131,000 per year.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year - USD $145,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Production Systems Engineer, AI Network
description:
Meta is seeking a Systems Engineer to join our Release to Production New Product Introduction (RTP-NPI) team working on AI/ML initiatives supporting large-scale AI training and inference. Our servers and data centers are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure operates efficiently to deliver our innovative services. The RTP team is responsible for the end-to-end hardware lifecycle of all Meta servers, including prototyping of experimental HW, pre-production hands-on system and hardware debugging and stress testing, enabling production-ready system monitoring, automated provisioning, and automated remediation of issues, ultimately certifying new platforms for mass production for AI at datacenter scale.

RTP Engineers have a large swath of cross-functional partners they work closely with, e.g., HW/SW co-design teams, hardware designers, networking teams, system manufacturers, component vendors, capacity engineering, production engineering, production services, and data center operations teams to enable new systems that will be deployed in our production data centers.

We are looking for a candidate who can drive scale up and scale out network technologies for Meta AI systems that are powering Meta’s tremendous leaps in the AI space. An ideal candidate is knowledgeable about network technologies (NICs, Switches, Optics, DACs, Protocols-TCP/IP, RDMA) and has hands-on experience supporting them through at least a couple of hardware/software (firmware, driver) lifecycle phases: design and bring-up, server integration, system validation, supporting customer deployment, production issue triage, rolling out new features in FW/Driver.

title: Senior Healthcare Application Developer (Remote Opportunity)
description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Healthcare Application Developer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role develops secure, scalable healthcare applications and reusable components using FHIR data and interoperability services. The work includes SMART on FHIR applications, CDS Hooks services, and digital quality-measure and HEDIS capabilities.

The specialist works highly independently and may lead a work group. The role collaborates with solution architects, FHIR and interface engineers, testers, and external partners.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and support healthcare applications and reusable application components that use FHIR data and standardized interoperability services.
  • Develop the SMART on FHIR application framework, prioritized healthcare applications, and CDS Hooks services.
  • Build digital quality-measure and HEDIS capabilities and integrate applications with clinical and quality data services.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable solutions for clinical, payer-provider, public-health, and quality-reporting use cases.
  • Develop application logic, user-facing workflows, backend services, and integration components.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and external partners on testing, troubleshooting, documentation, deployment, and knowledge transfer.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 or more years of related application development experience.
  • Experience developing modern web applications, including front-end and back-end components.
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs using JSON and SQL.
  • Experience with Java or a similar programming language and JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Ability to analyze business and technical requirements and solve complex application and integration problems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and provide technical leadership when needed.

Additional Qualifications

title: Product Designer
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, engaging, and user-centered digital experiences across our web and mobile products. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, and other stakeholders to solve complex problems through thoughtful design and data-informed decision making.

This role requires a strong understanding of UX and UI design principles, exceptional communication skills, and expert proficiency in Figma.

This is a role in our audience development digital marketing group and will focus on platforms that include the Bravo, NBC Insider, Peacock Blog consumer facing web platforms along with our B2B NBC Affiliate Marketing application. This is an onsite role in our New York or LA Office where expectations are being in Office Monday through Thursday and remote day on Fridays.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from discovery through final implementation.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering and Stakeholders to define product requirements and user experiences.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Design responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and incorporate user research and usability findings into design decisions.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to communicate concepts and validate solutions.
  • Work within and contribute to the company’s design system to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers during implementation to ensure design quality and accuracy.
  • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, experimentation, and business goals.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product design.

Basic Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products for web and/or mobile applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma is required, including:
    • Auto Layout
    • Components and Variants
    • Variables
    • Design Systems
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Dev Mode and developer handoff
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work and problem-solving skills.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and visual design.
  • Experience creating wireframes, user flows, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly and present work to stakeholders.
  • Experience working within Agile product development teams.
  • Strong collaboration, organization, and time management skills.
  • Required Skills
    • Figma (required)
    • User Experience (UX) Design
    • User Interface (UI) Design
    • Wireframing
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Design Systems
    • Information Architecture
    • Visual Design
    • Responsive Design
    • Accessibility (WCAG)
    • Cross-functional Collaboration
    • Problem Solving
    • Communication and Presentation

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.
  • Experience conducting usability testing or working with UX research.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing and data-informed product decisions.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience designing subscription, B2B, or content-driven digital products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Delivers polished, user-centered designs that solve customer and business needs.
  • Collaborates effectively across Product, Engineering, and Design teams.
  • Produces high-quality Figma files that are organized, scalable, and developer-friendly.
  • Uses research, analytics, and user feedback to continuously improve product experiences.
  • Contributes to the evolution of the design system and overall design quality.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.
  • Salary range: $85,000- $110,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. title: Marketing & Brand Designer (Contractor)
description:

You will mostly work alongside our Head of Marketing. Up until now, he has executed all design himself or has relied on disparate freelancers and agencies. This will be the first time the company brings on a long-term designer.

You will also occasionally work with the Head of Sales and Head of Customer Success to help produce sales enablement material and customer marketing material.

What you'll do

  • Sales enablement material: deal rooms, sales decks, one-pagers, and other collateral that help our sales team win deals.
