  • Events: trade show and conference materials, including booth graphics and print collateral
  • Implementation with AI: we build our site with AI tools, but we want a human to design first. You'll take your own Figma designs and use tools like Claude Code to help implement them on our site
  • Figma cleanup: restructure our existing Figma workspace into a clear, organized system (components, styles, templates) that a team can easily use
  • Visual identity: over time, help us refine, unify, and strengthen Mobly's brand identity across every touchpoint

As you get to know the business, you'll become our design expert and help shape how Mobly looks and feels everywhere!

Who you are

  • You're looking for a stable, long-term client relationship, not one-off projects
  • You have a portfolio that includes B2B SaaS work
  • You're highly skilled in Figma (auto layout, components, design systems) and you design with development in mind
  • You take initiative to understand the product, the market, and competitive trends without being asked
  • You think like a creative partner and are comfortable proposing ideas and pushing back when something could be better
  • You're AI-native: you've been experimenting with AI in your design workflow and are excited to use tools like Claude Code to bring designs to life
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English, both async and live

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of marketing design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Deep expertise in Figma and understanding of building design systems
  • Part-time, around 15–20 hours per week
  • You'll be responsive in our Slack during core working hours (9am - 2pm MST) and join a weekly sync with the Head of Marketing. (We will always try and provide sufficient lead time for deliverables, but sometimes things come up fast.)
  • Genuine excitement to produce fun and creative work
  • Okay with a contractor role on a monthly retainer
  • Flexible work - we are looking for someone who can contribute 15-20 hours/week. Work can be done whenever works for your schedule, but we'd love responsiveness during core hours (9am - 2pm MST)
  • Fully remote - work from wherever works for you!
  • Flexible PTO - Since this is a contractor role, you are free to take time as needed so long as communicated clearly
  • Competitive Compensation - monthly retainer range of $1,750 - $3,000, depending on experience

description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities.   • Strong online research skills are required to identify and obtain AML/KYC, regulatory, corporate governance and Modern Slavery documents from official sources and company websites

Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use
Education

Responsibilities
Entry level position supporting the collection, validation and maintenance of AML/KYC, regulatory and Modern Slavery documentation to enhance Moody's global compliance data offerings

The team contributes to Moody's by expanding document coverage across our compliance data products, improving the quality and accuracy of compliance data available to customers, and providing access to documentation that supports due diligence, regulatory compliance and compliance health check activities. As an intern, you'll develop a foundational understanding of underwriting by analyzing business and financial information, learning how risks are evaluated and priced, and contributing to meaningful projects alongside experienced professionals. Global Risk Solutions provides commercial and specialty insurance, surety, and reinsurance solutions for mid-sized, large, and multinational organizations. title: Principal Software Engineer
location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
description:
Overview

Microsoft brings together passionate innovators to collaborate, imagine what is possible, and build solutions in a cloud- and AI-enabled world.

The Global Skilling Product Team (GSPT) develops innovative products and experiences that help customers, partners, sellers, and future generations skill, upskill, and reskill. Our goal is to reach more than 100 million learners through accessible, high-quality learning experiences across Microsoft Learn and other digital platforms.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical authority responsible for designing and delivering scalable learning and skilling solutions. You will modernize content operations, use AI-assisted capabilities to improve how content is created and distributed, and help make learning available across Microsoft Learn, YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, and other channels. You will translate business needs, workflow constraints, and success criteria into secure, reliable solutions and measurable outcomes. Working across product, operations, partner, and engineering teams, you will guide solutions from discovery through production adoption using the right combination of Copilot, AI agents, Power Platform, Azure services, and custom software. This individual-contributor role requires influence across organizational boundaries without direct people-management responsibility.

If you thrive in collaborative, agile environments and enjoy solving complex real-world problems, we would like to hear from you.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their highly qualified contributions each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.



Responsibilities

Provide principal-level technical leadership while remaining directly accountable for architecture, code, delivery, and engineering outcomes.

The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for the following:

  • Design architectures that connect workflows, data, and enterprise services, including interfaces, data contracts, dependencies, access boundaries, failure handling, and upstream and downstream impacts.
  • Lead the full software lifecycle for skilling platform features: requirements, architecture, application and database design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Write, review, debug, and ship production-quality software, leading critical components and resolving complex issues while balancing delivery speed, performance, extensibility, and maintainability.
  • Select and apply Copilot, AI agents, Power Platform, Azure services, reusable platforms, and custom software based on business value, feasibility, risk, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Partner with product, business, and operations stakeholders to understand end-to-end scenarios, handoffs, exceptions, bottlenecks, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
  • Co-engineer with partner teams and engineering counterparts to align designs, interfaces, dependencies, milestones, acceptance criteria, and support handoffs; resolve disagreements through evidence and influence.
  • Build in security, least-privilege access, privacy, and Responsible AI. Evaluate AI quality and safety, control data access, and provide auditability and human oversight.
  • Establish automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, documentation, and deployment safeguards for repeatable and supportable delivery.
  • Engineer reliable services with telemetry, actionable alerts, diagnostics, recovery procedures, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvements to service health and operational readiness.
  • Create reusable components, integration patterns, and guidance that reduce duplication, with clear ownership, lifecycle maintenance, and knowledge-transfer plans.

Mentorship, Technical Community, and Talent Scaling

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, and constructive feedback, strengthening architectural judgment, engineering discipline, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Scale impact through reusable guidance, documentation, and learning sessions that build alignment and capability across technical communities.

Other

  • Embody our culture and values


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 10+ years of technical engineering experience, or a bachelor’s degree and 12+ years of experience,
    • OR equivalent experience.

title: Senior Content Strategist
description:
Overview

In Global Consumer eCommerce Marketing our purpose is to drive growth by building emotional connections that delight and empower customers. We engage with consumers globally throughout their shopping journeys across Gaming, Windows, Microsoft 365 and Surface. As a member of our team, you will help grow a multi-billion-dollar business, explore new areas of innovation and influence digital experiences used by customers around the world.

The Senior Content Strategist shapes how customers understand, compare and choose Microsoft products across Microsoft.com. This role defines the content strategy and product-knowledge structure behind our global digital commerce experiences. It establishes how product truth, customer guidance, comparisons and buying information should be organized and represented so that customers and AI-powered experiences can understand and use it accurately.

This role creates the strategy, models, and standards that guide how content is produced, whether by marketers, copywriters, agencies or AI. The strategist ensures that content is meaningful and useful for customers while also structured, consistent, and trustworthy enough to support Search, personalization, conversational experiences, and emerging agent-assisted shopping scenarios.

This role works closely with Site Merchandising, UX, SEO/AI SEO, product marketing, Engineering, Analytics and digital transformation teams. It connects customer needs and business priorities to the content and product knowledge required across global commerce journeys.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Define the commerce content strategy: Develop and evolve the content strategy for Microsoft Store and priority Microsoft.com commerce experiences, aligned to customer needs, business goals, and global scale.
  • Create reusable content models: Design scalable frameworks for common customer needs, including frequently asked questions, comparisons, buying guides, product-value frameworks, use-case guidance, and recommendation experiences.
  • Define product-knowledge requirements and establish product truth: Define how product claims, terminology, attributes, relationships, use cases, and comparisons should be represented consistently across customer experiences.
  • Design human and machine decision journeys: Translate customer questions, product complexity, and journey friction into clear buying guidance, decision-support experiences, and product-knowledge requirements.
  • Lead content and commerce taxonomy strategy: Define the terminology, categories, attributes, and relationships used to organize commerce content. Partner with Search on query intent, synonyms, retrieval, filters, and relevance; with UX on information architecture; and with product-data teams on authoritative specifications and source systems.
  • Partner with SEO and AI SEO: Convert search demand, customer questions, visibility gaps and citation opportunities into prioritized content strategies.
  • Improve content quality and consistency: Establish standards and governance for terminology, naming, comparison logic, freshness, accuracy, and ownership across marketing and merchandising experiences.
  • Simplify customer decision-making: Lead audits to identify content gaps, duplication, conflicting product information, and opportunities to make complex choices easier to understand.
  • Use data to improve the experience: Apply customer signals, content performance, search insights, and experimentation to determine which content patterns improve discovery, comprehension, comparison, conversion, and long-term customer value.
  • Advance AI-enabled experiences responsibly: Ensure product knowledge is clear, structured and reliable enough to support Search, conversational experiences, and emerging shopping agents without compromising accuracy or customer trust.
  • Partner on scaled capabilities: Define the content models, standards and business requirements that product and engineering teams can operationalize through shared tools, workflows, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Increase speed and efficiency: Identify opportunities to reduce duplicated content, repeated interpretation, unnecessary handoffs and external-vendor dependency through reusable standards and more effective use of AI.
  • Influence across organizational boundaries: Build strong partnerships and influence product, platform and experience decisions across teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Embody our Culture & Values.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Social Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Communications, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 3+ years experience in retail, customer service, ecommerce, data science, research, marketing or business-related roles OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Social Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Communications, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in retail, customer service, ecommerce, data science, research, marketing or business-related roles OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in content strategy, content design, information architecture, taxonomy, ecommerce, digital product management or related roles.
  • Experience defining content strategy and governance for complex global digital experiences.
  • Experience with product taxonomy, content modeling, structured content, information architecture or product-knowledge systems.
  • Understanding of ecommerce discovery, evaluation, comparison and purchase journeys.
  • Working knowledge of search engine optimization, AI-search optimization and AI-influenced customer discovery.
  • Experience using customer research, performance data and experimentation to inform content or product decisions.
  • Experience translating content and customer-experience requirements into specifications for technical or product teams.
  • Practical experience using AI to research, prototype, analyze or improve content and digital workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver results across large, matrixed organizations.
  • Ability to move between strategy, detailed problem-solving and hands-on experimentation.
  • A builder mindset focused on creating reusable systems and improving how work gets done.

You'll work alongside experienced underwriters to evaluate complex risks, develop insurance solutions, and make strategic business decisions that support both our customers and Liberty Mutual's continued success.

Underwriting combines analytical thinking, business acumen, relationship management, and negotiation. You'll assess business operations, financial information, and industry trends to determine whether risks are appropriate for Liberty Mutual and help establish pricing and coverage solutions that meet customer needs.

Liberty Mutual's Global Risk Solutions (GRS) business provides commercial and specialty insurance, surety, and reinsurance solutions for midsize, large, and global businesses. Across a broad range of industries, GRS helps organizations navigate complex and evolving risks while protecting their people, property, operations, and future growth.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze business information, financial data, and industry trends to evaluate risk.
  • Learn how insurance products and risk management solutions support businesses across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with brokers, customers, and internal teams to understand client needs and develop tailored insurance solutions.
  • Build strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Develop expertise in risk selection, coverage analysis, and pricing strategies.
  • Make informed business decisions that balance customer needs with profitable growth objectives.

Training & Development

As an Associate Underwriter, you'll participate in the Underwriting Development Program starting in June 2027, a blended learning experience designed to build the technical, analytical, and business skills needed for a successful underwriting career.

During your first six months, you'll participate in a structured onboarding and development experience that combines formal coursework with hands-on underwriting responsibilities. You'll receive support from experienced underwriting professionals and a dedicated learning liaison within the business as you apply classroom concepts to real-world underwriting situations. Through the program, you'll:

  • Build a foundation in underwriting principles, risk assessment, coverage analysis, and pricing.
  • Gain hands-on experience evaluating risks and developing insurance solutions for commercial customers.
  • Learn alongside a cohort of peers while building your professional network.
  • Receive ongoing coaching, mentorship, and field support from underwriting professionals.
  • Develop the knowledge and skills needed to grow your career within underwriting.

This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location.

We encourage interested candidates to apply promptly, as the role may be unposted once we’ve received a sufficient number of candidates. We conduct interviews and extend offers on a rolling basis.

What you’ve got

title: Logistics Coordinator - MO
description:
Logistics Coordinator

Location: Onsite – Marshfield, MO
Reporting to: DCO

At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
STN Incorporated is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to support the efficient operation of our data center environments. This role is responsible for coordinating the movement, storage, tracking, and delivery of critical IT infrastructure assets, including servers, network equipment, racks, cables, spare parts, and facility components. The Logistics Coordinator will ensure inventory accuracy, support asset lifecycle management, coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and maintain compliance with company security and operational standards. Data center logistics requires precise coordination of hardware, inventory, and deployment schedules to support uptime and operational reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Inventory & Asset Management
  • Maintain accurate inventory records for servers, network equipment, spare parts, tools, and consumables.
  • Perform cycle counts, inventory audits, and reconciliation activities.
  • Track asset movement from receiving through deployment, redeployment, and decommissioning.
  • Ensure all inventory transactions are accurately documented in asset management and inventory systems.
  • Monitor stock levels and coordinate replenishment of critical spare parts and operational supplies.
Shipping & Receiving
  • Coordinate and process inbound and outbound shipments of IT equipment and infrastructure materials.
  • Verify deliveries against purchase orders and packing slips.
  • Prepare shipping documentation and coordinate carrier pickups.
  • Track shipments and proactively resolve transportation or delivery issues.
  • Manage RMA (Return Material Authorization) shipments and vendor returns.
Data Center Operations Support
  • Stage equipment for deployment, maintenance, and project activities.
  • Coordinate with Data Center Technicians, Operations teams, Procurement, and vendors to ensure hardware availability.
  • Support hardware installation schedules by ensuring equipment is received, inventoried, and available when needed.
  • Assist with decommissioning projects and secure disposition of retired assets.
  • Maintain organized storage areas, cages, and equipment rooms.
Vendor & Carrier Coordination
  • Serve as a point of contact for suppliers, freight carriers, and logistics providers.
  • Schedule deliveries and coordinate site access requirements.
  • Ensure vendors comply with facility security and operational procedures.
  • Coordinate delivery timelines for critical infrastructure projects.
Compliance & Documentation
  • Maintain accurate records for audits, asset tracking, and inventory reporting.
  • Follow chain-of-custody procedures for high-value IT assets.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and data center security requirements.
  • Generate inventory, shipment, and asset lifecycle reports for management review.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 2–5 years of experience in logistics, inventory control, warehouse operations, or supply chain management.
  • Experience in a data center, technology, manufacturing, or mission-critical environment preferred.
  • Experience with inventory management, ERP, WMS, or asset tracking systems.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and inventory reporting tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Preferred
  • Experience supporting data center operations or IT infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with servers, networking equipment, racks, and structured cabling.
  • Knowledge of asset lifecycle management and hardware tracking.
  • Experience with DCIM, ServiceNow, NetSuite, SAP, or similar platforms.
  • Forklift certification or warehouse equipment experience (if applicable).
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and work in warehouse and data center environments for extended periods.
  • Ability to safely move and stage racks, servers, and IT hardware.
  • Ability to work occasional evenings, weekends, or on-call schedules to support critical operations.

Compensation

  • Full-Time, Exempt
  • Marshfield, MO: $50,000-$70,000/year, DOE

Benefits

  • FSA Health and Dependent Care available

  • Observed Holidays Paid
  • Cell Phone Allowance
  • Collaborative, growth-driven culture

title: RIS Data Migration Engineer
description:
The Role:

The RIS Data Migration Engineer is responsible for overseeing and executing the migration of data between Radiology Information Systems (RIS), ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and compliance with regulatory standards. The Data Migration Engineer will work closely with IT, clinical, and administrative teams to ensure seamless transitions of data from legacy systems to modern platforms, while optimizing workflows and maintaining the highest standards of patient data privacy and security.

Responsibilities:
· Develop and execute comprehensive strategies for RIS data migration.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse migration requirements.

· Extract clinical, operational, and administrative data from legacy RIS systems.

· Assess and map legacy data structures, including patient demographic records, diagnostic radiology reports, scanned documents, and future appointments.

· Assist in assembling and loading RIS system’s master lists including referring physicians, insurance providers, procedure codes, billing codes, organizational structures such as practices, sites, and rooms, and other master look-up tables.

· Use ETL tools to clean, transform, and prepare data for migration.

· Provide post-migration support for product go-live implementations.

· Partner with cross-functional teams, including customers, IT staff, compliance officers, and third-party vendors.

· Document the entire migration process, including methodologies, tools, and reports.

· Train staff on how to manage, access, and use data in the new RIS system.

· Perform comprehensive validation to ensure data completeness and resolve inconsistencies.

· Conduct post-migration verification and prepare detailed reports for stakeholders.

· Identify and resolve migration-related issues, such as data inconsistencies or system compatibility challenges.

Requirements:
· Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, healthcare informatics, or related field; or equivalent professional experience

· 3+ years proven experience in data migration within a healthcare environment

· Hands-on experience with data manipulation and/or migration within RIS, PACS, HIS, and EMR systems.

· Proficiency in ETL processes, database structures, SQL, and healthcare data standards.

· Proficient SQL skills and experience with database management. Proprietary software product is supported by MS SQL Server. Proficiency with Transact SQL, triggers, functions, stored procedures, database schema design, SQL agent jobs, and ad hoc querying.

· Using skills above, work with various formats of data such as CSV and other delimited text files, Excel data, SQL databases, Word docs, BMP/JPG files, PDF files. Ad hoc manipulation such as converting one format to another, rename files, move files, parse files, clean data.

· Excellent technical communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization

· Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities

· Ability to adapt to constantly changing projects. This role requires a high level of self-motivation, self-management, initiative, and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks effectively. Occasional off-hours work is required to migrate during off-peak system times.

· Attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and security. Comfort and willingness to handle and analyze and scrutinize large medical record datasets is a critical aspect of the job to maintain high data quality standards

· Proficiency in C# for Windows desktop programming or Python, or similar programming languages to enhance in-house data migration tools.

· Familiarity with Linux OS and scripting (Python, Pearl, VIM, BASH) to assist with ancillary data migrations taking place in Linux environments.

· Mirth skills, particularly with HL7

Quality Standards

· Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, patients, visitors, and vendors.

· Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

· Follows all local, state and federal laws concerning employment to include but not limited to: I-9, Harassment, EEOC, Civil rights and ADA.

· Follows OSHA regulations, RadNet and site protocols, policies and procedures.

· Follows HIPAA, compliance, privacy, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

· Practices universal safety precautions.

· Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

· Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

· Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with RadNet guidelines.

· Consistently adheres to the time management policies and procedures.

· Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

title: Project Manager-Wet Utilities (Hybrid Work Possibility)
description:

description:

Position Description

PingWind is seeking an Configuration Management Specialist II who will provide technical, analytical, and lifecycle support to the Maritime Electronic Warfare Systems Division (MEWSD) for critical U.S. Navy Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Decoy, and Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP) systems. title: Director Business Strategy, CAIP Planning Lead
description:
Overview

The Commercial Solution Area (CSA) and Cloud and AI Platforms (CAIP) Solution Area are pivotal in driving innovation and delivering comprehensive solutions to our customers. Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more by providing cutting-edge cloud and AI technologies. We are committed to enhancing customer engagement, optimizing business processes, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

The CAIP Sales Strategy, Planning & Excellence team’s mission is to drive world-class operational rigor through strategic planning and actionable insights, enabling the Field, GTM, and GBB organizations to shape strategy, simplify execution, and accelerate business growth. Within that team, the Planning, Operations & Insights group owns the annual planning cycle, the CAIP operating rhythm, and the business insights that inform executive decision-making.

Annual planning is the cross-functional process for aligning GTM, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and E&O around a cohesive annual strategy for CAIP. The CAIP Planning Lead owns all-up planning orchestration for the solution area, ensuring business priorities, product positioning, MPF, execution of motions, investment decisions, blueprint and RolEx, compensation, territory design, and operational readiness are connected into one integrated approach before the new fiscal year begins.

Leading through influence, the CAIP Planning Lead sets the strategic direction and governance for integrated planning across the solution area. This leader aligns cross-functional priorities, connects interdependent choices, and creates the conditions for timely, high-quality decisions across GTM, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and E&O. Workstream owners remain accountable for their recommendations and outcomes, while the Planning Lead challenges assumptions, resolves competing priorities, and elevates material trade-offs to executive sponsors to ensure the final plan reflects a coherent strategy and positions CAIP for growth.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Own the end-to-end annual planning cycle for CAIP: translate company and commercial planning guidance into the CAIP planning approach, and define workstreams and ownership across strategy, revenue and investments, resource design, blueprint and sales model, territories, compensation, GTM motions, partner strategy, Marketing, tooling, and landing.
  • Build and maintain the master workback, converting central planning milestones, CAIP milestones, executive review dates, Finance deadlines, and operational cutoffs into a single source of truth for cadence, deliverable timing, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Create and run planning pods and working groups that bring BA owners, GTM leads, Marketing, Finance, and Operations together, each with clear ownership, deliverables, timelines, and escalation paths.
  • Coordinate stakeholder input and reviews through recurring forums planning lead reviews, GTM working sessions, Marketing alignment, Finance and territory reviews, and executive readouts to collect input, pressure-test assumptions, surface trade-offs, and land decisions.
  • Prepare executive review materials, coordinating the story, templates, inputs, and review process so strategy, headcount, compensation, blueprint, territory, and execution implications are presented cohesively.
  • Finalize and land the plan: archive final materials in the central planning site, document open issues, and give downstream teams clear guidance on what changed, what is final, and what still needs follow-up.
  • Maintain the governance backbone, the decision and escalation log, the risk register, the workstream owner roster, and the central repository structure ensuring planning decisions are traceable and prior-year materials are reusable.
  • Apply AI and automation to the planning cycle using agentic workflows and Copilot tooling to reduce manual coordination, keep trackers current, and scale the operating rhythm.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration or related field AND 4+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Liberal Arts, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration or related field AND 6+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Liberal Arts, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years experience in Strategy, Management Consulting, and/or Finance.
  • 6+ years of experience in business consulting, sales, sales operations, information technology (IT), account management, business development, marketing, IT field sales, or a related field — OR equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end annual or fiscal planning cycle in a large, matrixed organization at senior individual-contributor level, including the workback plan, governance model, and executive review moments.
  • Expertise in financial planning, business analytics, and data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions.
  • Experience working within an Azure or cloud technology environment.
  • Track record of influencing without authority across Finance, GTM, Marketing, and the field, and of simplifying complexity into action under ambiguity and time pressure.

title: Director of Parks and Recreation
description:
The Ideal Candidate:

Des Moines is looking for a creative, energetic and collaborative leader who sees possibilities and is ready to roll up their sleeves. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker and team builder who is equally comfortable navigating the practical realities of day to day operations.

The successful candidate will bring strong financial and operational judgement, communicate effectively with employees, city leadership, elected officials, community members and partners, and understand how to balance priorities with available resources.

Most importantly, the City is looking for someone who can see the potential in what Des Moines already has and bring the leadership, creativity and energy needed to turn that potential into meaningful results for the community.

About Community Enrichment Services:

Our Community Enrichment Services offers social, educational and recreational programs that support health and lifelong learning in Des Moines. Our program areas include Senior Services, Youth Programs, Camps, Sports, and Special Events.

The Community of Des Moines:

Des Moines is a mostly residential community that is situated along Puget Sounds midway between Seattle and Tacoma in Washington State. The city is long and narrow, 603 miles long and 2.1 wide covering 4, 340 acres. It includes various parks, fields, waterfront and trails.

To learn more about the structure, budget and community programs within Parks and Recreation, see our attached recruitment flyer.

Closing Date:

Open until filled. First review of applications on Monday, October 26, 2026.

Salary:

$156,362.23 - $197,662.30 annually. DOE

To Apply

Complete the online application at and attach a resume and cover letter describing your interest in the position and relevant leadership experience.

Nature of Work

The Parks & Recreation Director serves as a key member of the City's executive leadership team and provides strategic and operational leadership for the City's parks and recreation system. The Director is responsible for the overall direction, performance and administration of the department, including parks and open spaces, recreation programs, senior services, facilities, rentals, community events and other assigned services and initiatives.

The Director leads long-range planning and establishes department priorities that align with City Council direction, the City's Strategic Plan, community needs and available resources. The position is responsible for department operations, financial management, capital and asset planning, service delivery, community engagement, partnerships and the development of a high-performing team.

The Director leads in a dynamic, resource-conscious environment that requires the ability to move effectively between long-range strategy and day-to-day problem solving. The Director is expected to be visible, accessible and actively engaged with employees, programs, facilities and community activities while maintaining responsibility for the overall direction and performance of the department.

Essential Functions

  • Provides strategic and operational leadership for the City's parks and recreation system and establishes department goals, priorities, work plans and performance expectations consistent with City priorities and community needs.
  • Leads the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of the City's Parks & Recreation Master Plan and other long-range plans, translating adopted priorities into realistic work plans, investments and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversees the delivery and continuous improvement of recreation programs, senior services, parks, facilities, rentals, community events and other assigned services with a focus on community benefit, accessibility, quality and responsible use of City resources.
  • Provides leadership for the stewardship, maintenance and improvement of City parks, open spaces, facilities and recreational assets and establishes priorities for their long-term care and use.
  • Develops and manages the department's operating and capital budgets; monitors revenues and expenditures, evaluates financial performance and recommends priorities and resource allocations consistent with available funding.
  • Develops financially sustainable approaches to programs and services, including evaluation of fees, cost recovery, facility utilization, service delivery models, partnerships, grants and other funding opportunities.
  • Uses financial, operational, participation and community information to evaluate programs and services, identify opportunities for improvement and make recommendations regarding continuation, modification, expansion or development of services.
  • Provides leadership for capital planning and park and facility improvement projects; establishes priorities, participates in project development and coordinates with Public Works (Engineering), consultants, contractors and other partners responsible for project delivery.
  • Selects, develops, supervises and evaluates assigned employees; establishes clear expectations, promotes accountability and supports professional development and effective teamwork.
  • Builds effective relationships with residents, community organizations, schools, businesses, nonprofit organizations and regional partners to expand opportunities, strengthen services and leverage community resources.
  • Develops and supports meaningful community engagement processes to understand community needs, identify barriers to participation and ensure programs, services and investments respond to the community.
  • Establishes and maintains productive relationships with City advisory bodies and provides appropriate staff support, professional recommendations and guidance consistent with their established roles.
  • Prepares and presents recommendations, reports and updates to the City Manager, City Council and advisory bodies regarding department operations, policies, programs, projects, budgets and emerging issues.
  • Responds to complex or sensitive community concerns, operational issues and service challenges and develops practical solutions that balance community needs, City policies and available resources.
  • Represents the City at community meetings, regional organizations, professional associations and other public forums.
  • Participates as a member of the City's executive leadership team and contributes to Citywide strategic planning, organizational initiatives, policy development and problem solving.
  • Establishes and maintains cooperative, effective working relationships with co-workers, other City employees, and the general public using principles of good customer service.
  • Reports for scheduled work with regular, reliable and punctual attendance.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Necessary Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Knowledge of:

  • Principles, practices and current trends in municipal parks and recreation administration, programming, facility operations and parks management.
  • Strategic and long-range planning, including development and implementation of parks and recreation master plans.
  • Municipal budgeting, financial management, revenue forecasting, cost recovery and capital planning.
  • Methods for evaluating program performance, community benefit, participation, service levels and financial sustainability.
  • Parks and facility asset management, maintenance planning and capital improvement practices.
  • Recreation programming and community service delivery for diverse ages, abilities, backgrounds and interests.
  • Community engagement practices and methods for identifying and responding to changing community needs.
  • Principles of organizational leadership, supervision, employee development, performance management and team building.
  • Public administration, municipal governance and the roles and relationships of the City Council, City Manager, departments and advisory bodies.
  • Grant development and administration and public, private and nonprofit partnership models.
  • Contract development, negotiation and administration.
  • Applicable federal, state and local laws, regulations and policies affecting parks and recreation operations.
  • Principles of risk management and public safety as they relate to parks, facilities, programs and community events.
  • Project management and the planning and delivery of capital and operational initiatives.

Ability to:

  • Provide both strategic and operational leadership within a multifaceted municipal department.
  • Develop a clear vision and translate long-range goals into achievable priorities, work plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Move effectively between executive-level responsibilities and direct involvement in operational issues when needed.
  • Develop and manage complex operating and capital budgets and make sound recommendations regarding priorities, tradeoffs and allocation of limited resources.
  • Evaluate programs, services and operations using financial, performance and community information and make recommendations for improvement.
  • Lead organizational change, establish expectations and develop a collaborative, accountable and service-oriented team.
  • Coach, develop, supervise and evaluate employees and effectively delegate responsibilities.
  • Build productive relationships with elected officials, employees, residents, community organizations, businesses, schools and regional partners.
  • Understand community needs and develop programs, services and partnerships that improve access and participation.
  • Communicate complex information clearly and persuasively, both orally and in writing.
  • Prepare and deliver effective presentations and recommendations to the City Manager, City Council, advisory bodies and community groups.
  • Navigate the political and organizational environment of local government with sound judgment, professionalism and appropriate discretion.
  • Analyze complex issues, identify alternatives and develop practical, financially responsible solutions.
  • Manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing operational needs and unexpected circumstances.
  • Negotiate and administer contracts, agreements and partnerships.
  • Lead and coordinate projects involving multiple departments, consultants, contractors and community partners.
  • Exercise independent judgment and make timely decisions within delegated authority.
  • Remain visible, accessible and engaged with employees and department operations while maintaining an appropriate executive perspective.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in parks and recreation administration, public administration, business administration or a closely related field; AND
  • Five years of progressively responsible experience in parks and recreation, public administration or a closely related field, including significant responsibility for programs, personnel, budgets, facilities and/or organizational operations, with at least three years in a supervisory or management capacity; OR
  • A combination of education, training and experience that provides the knowledge, skills and abilities necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position may be considered.
  • Certified Park and Recreation Professional (CPRP) or Certified Park and Recreation Executive (CPRE) credential is preferred.
  • Municipal or other public sector parks and recreation leadership experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience with parks and recreation master planning, capital planning, community engagement, financial sustainability and organizational development is desirable.

Special Requirements

  • Possession of and ability to maintain a valid Washington State Driver's License with a good driving record.
  • Successful completion of a criminal history and pre-employment background check.
  • Ability to attend evening and weekend meetings, programs and community events as necessary.
  • Ability to respond to significant operational issues or emergencies outside regular business hours when necessary.

Working Conditions and Physical Abilities

  • Work is performed in both office and field environments. The Director regularly visits parks, recreation facilities, community facilities, programs, events, project sites and other City locations.
  • Work requires frequent interaction with employees, elected officials, community members, contractors, consultants and partner organizations and may involve resolving sensitive, complex or contentious issues.
  • Evening and weekend work is required periodically for City Council meetings, community meetings, programs, events and other department activities.
  • Field work may include exposure to varying weather conditions, uneven terrain, active construction or maintenance areas and normal conditions associated with public parks, facilities and community events.
  • The position requires the ability to communicate effectively, use standard office technology, travel between City facilities and sites and perform the physical activities necessary to observe and participate in department operations.

Liberty Mutual is looking for a managing attorney to lead legal support for one of our largest and fastest-moving businesses.

title: Operations Research Analyst III
description:
Required Clearance: Secret
Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree
Required Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience

Position Description

PingWind is seeking an Operations Research Analyst III who will provide technical, analytical, and lifecycle support to the Maritime Electronic Warfare Systems Division (MEWSD) for critical U.S. Navy Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Decoy, and Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP) systems. This role supports cradle-to-grave activities, including engineering, technology transition, installation, logistics, product support, test and evaluation, sustainment, maintenance, and repair. The Operations Research Analyst III will integrate logistics, data science, reliability and maintainability engineering, and operations research to analyze and model complex systems, improve operational availability, and support data-driven decisions. This position directly contributes to optimizing warfighting capability, system readiness, reliability, and lifecycle performance while balancing mission requirements, performance, and cost.

Responsibilities

Typical Responsibilities/Tasks:
• Apply mathematical, scientific, engineering, and analytical methods to evaluate complex operational and organizational challenges.
• Analyze the effective use and allocation of personnel, funding, materials, equipment, and other resources to improve operational performance.
• Support strategic planning, forecasting, resource allocation, performance measurement, and scheduling activities.
• Gather, validate, organize, and analyze information from large and complex datasets to support data-driven decision-making.
• Select and apply appropriate analytical techniques, including simulation, linear and nonlinear programming, dynamic programming, queuing models, stochastic-process models, and analytic hierarchy processes.
• Develop mathematical and analytical models that represent complex systems, processes, operational environments, and resource relationships.
• Conduct modeling, simulation, and what-if analyses to evaluate how changes in resources, requirements, constraints, or operating conditions may affect system performance.
• Analyze supply chain, transportation, distribution, logistics, and operational processes to identify efficiencies, constraints, risks, and performance improvements.
• Develop and evaluate alternative courses of action to support planning, optimization, and resource management decisions.
• Establish and assess performance measures and analytical metrics to evaluate system effectiveness and operational outcomes.
• Interpret analytical results and translate complex findings into clear recommendations, reports, visualizations, and decision-support products for technical and program leadership.

About Pingwind

PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. We have extensive experience in the fields of cybersecurity, development, IT infrastructure, supply chain management and other professional services such as system design and continuous improvement. PingWind is a VA CVE certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and SBA HUBZone Certified with offices in Washington DC and Northern Virginia.


Our benefits include:

· Eleven Federal Holidays
· Paid Time Off accrued each pay period
· Parental Leave
· Three medical plan choices with generous employer contribution
· Dental and Vision Insurance
· Company paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
· Company paid Life and AD&D Insurance
· 401k with competitive matching and vesting schedule
· Continuing education assistance
· Short Term / Long Term Disability & Life Insurance
· Medical, Dependent Care and Commuter Flexible Spending Accounts
· Employee Assistance Program
· Wellness benefits include Calm Health app and WellHub gym subsidy (formerly GymPass)
· 529 College Savings Plan
· Legal Insurance
· Pet Insurance

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow (2 Days/Wk)
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow

Location: New York City, NY

Schedule: Part-Time – 2 Days per Week

Department: Center for Technology-Based Education and Community Health

Reports To: Principal Investigator, Ian David Aronson, Ph.D.

Salary: see details below



The Opportunity

NDRI-USA is seeking a motivated and collaborative Postdoctoral Research Fellow to join an interdisciplinary research team working on an NIH/NIDA-funded project encouraging participants to protect themselves and others from overdose.

This position offers an opportunity to work with an established interdisciplinary research team and community leaders while developing expertise in applied public health research.

The Fellow will receive training and mentorship in qualitative and quantitative research methods and will have opportunities to contribute to conference presentations and peer-reviewed publications.

About Us

We are a mission-driven, not-for-profit research organization dedicated to improving public health and quality of life through innovative, high-impact research and collaboration. Our work addresses real-world challenges, informs policy, and drives meaningful change in the communities we serve.

What You’ll Do

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive literature reviews and synthesize relevant scientific research
  • Draft manuscripts, conference abstracts, and presentations

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Collect, organize, and analyze qualitative and quantitative research data as needed
  • Assist with preliminary and ongoing data analysis and interpretation
  • Participate in interdisciplinary research activities and contribute to a collaborative research environment
  • Perform other research-related duties as assigned by the Principal Investigator



What You Bring

  • Doctoral degree in public health, behavioral science, social and behavioral sciences, or a related field; advanced doctoral students nearing degree completion will also be considered
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to contribute to research publications
  • Strong research, analytical, organizational, and critical-thinking skills
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative research team
  • Ability and willingness to work on site at various locations throughout New York City, as directed by study leadership



What Sets You Apart

  • You have experience conducting qualitative and/or quantitative research
  • You have experience working with people who use drugs
  • You are proficient in speaking the Spanish language
  • You have lived or have living experience with substance use and/or the criminal justice system
  • You have experience with writing, conference presentations, and/or peer-reviewed scientific publications



Compensation & Schedule

This is a part-time position scheduled for two days per week.

title: Analyst Data Systems
description:
Job Overview
The Data Systems Analyst is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing districtwide stakeholder engagement and experience management systems that provide meaningful insights for decision-making and continuous improvement. This position develops surveys, feedback mechanisms, dashboards, and reporting tools that capture stakeholder voice and measure the effectiveness of district initiatives. The incumbent analyzes qualitative and quantitative data, monitors organizational performance, and identifies trends that support strategic planning and operational excellence. The Data Systems Analyst collaborates with departments to create data-driven solutions that improve processes, strengthen stakeholder engagement, and enhance organizational effectiveness. Additionally, the position develops and maintains interactive reporting systems that translate complex data into actionable information for district leaders and stakeholders.

Position Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Survey Platform Administration & Design

  • Serve as the district's primary administrator and point of contact for Qualtrics and related survey platforms, managing access, licensing, and platform configuration
  • Design, build, and deploy surveys, forms, and data collection instruments in support of district-wide initiatives aligned to the comprehensive stakeholder engagement plan, including stakeholder engagement, culture and climate assessments, enrollment processes, and organizational planning
  • Develop and manage automated workflows, distribution lists, and response tracking to ensure timely and accurate data collection
  • Ensure all survey instruments are aligned with research best practices and maintain appropriate data privacy and security standards
  • Continuously improve survey processes by monitoring platform updates, exploring new features, and identifying opportunities to enhance data collection efficiency
Data Analytics & Reporting
  • Analyze survey and organizational data using quantitative and qualitative methods to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Develop interactive dashboards and data visualizations that communicate key findings clearly to leadership, campus teams, and other stakeholders
  • Prepare written and oral reports related to assigned data initiatives for division leadership, district staff, and the Board of Trustees as needed
  • Assist with ad hoc data requests and queries in support of departmental and district priorities
  • Maintain organized data records and documentation to support ongoing reporting and longitudinal analysis
Research & Continuous Improvement Support
  • Support the design and implementation of program evaluations and research studies that assess the effectiveness of district initiatives and inform continuous improvement cycles
  • Assist with data collection and analysis efforts tied to strategic planning, district improvement planning, and accountability systems
  • Collaborate with department leads to align data collection efforts with organizational goals, board priorities, and state and federal requirements
  • Stay current on developments in survey methodology, data analytics, and educational research to inform best practices within the division
  • Perform other duties as assigned related to data, research, and evaluation functions
Stakeholder Support & Capacity Building
  • Provide training, guidance, and technical support to district staff on the use of survey platforms and data tools
  • Support data literacy efforts across the division by coaching teams on interpreting data and applying findings to decision-making
  • Serve as a collaborative partner to internal departments, supporting data-related needs that align with organizational development priorities

title: Protection And Control Specialist
description:
Protection and Control Specialist

Spark Power provides a wide range of services to clients, including power system field services, engineering services, maintenance planning, project management, automation services, mechanical engineering support services, training services, and thermographic scanning. The primary role of a Protection & Control Specialist is to perform programming, testing and verification of protection & control devices in the field. The role is responsible for testing, commission or maintain power distribution equipment. This position requires interfacing with clients, owners, consultants and construction crew and therefore strong oral and written communication skills are essential.

What you will do as the Protection and Control Specialist:

  • Maintain or Commission Power distribution equipment including Power Transformers, Circuit Breakers, HV Switches and Instrument Transformers.
  • Clarify or Modify Single Line and Three Line Drawing using AutoCAD.
  • Perform Short Circuit & Coordination Study, Ground Grid Design or Arc Flash Study. Perform site data collection when required.
  • Be safety conscious and have the willingness to learn Electrical Lockout/Tag-out procedures and gain Electrical Safety Awareness.
  • Read and interpret electrical AC & DC schematics, AC three-line, logic diagrams and SLDs. Inspect, test, operate and troubleshoot AC & DC control and protection wiring schematic.
  • Be familiar with industry-specific codes and Standards (OESC, IEEE, and NETA).
  • Ability and willingness to travel for out of town for commissioning or maintenance projects.
  • Familiarity or willing to gain familiarity with testing different types of high voltage and low voltage equipment.
  • Report, record, compute, and process electrical test information in accordance with accepted standard practices.
  • Co-ordinate the day-to-day functions on a job-by-job basis, such as but not limited to, compliance with all Health and Safety standards and regulations, availability of necessary resources such as human resources, equipment and materials, resolving conflicts, timely and accurate submission of paperwork.
  • Perform power system studies using EasyPower or ETAP including Load Flow, Harmonics, Short Circuit Analysis, Protective Device Coordination and Arc Flash Studies.

  • Continuous training and skills improvement
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Competitive wages plus incentive program
  • Excellent benefit package with wellness spending account options and corporate discounts
  • RRSP

  • ….and much more

  • Demonstrates thorough understanding of how each business unit adds value to the organization. Explores and addresses underlying, and long-term client needs while scanning the environment to identify new contacts.

  • 3-year Electrical Engineering Technology diploma with a focus in Power Systems or Bachelor of Electrical Engineering Degree.

Who is Spark Power?

Spark Power is the leading independent provider of end-to-end electrical services and operations and maintenance services to the industrial, utility, and renewable asset markets in North America. title: On-Site Service Coordinator (contract)
description:
Scandinavian Building Services has been a Canadian leader in retail and commercial cleaning for the last 60 years. Starting as a small family owned and operated business in Edmonton Alberta in 1956 to offering full service janitorial and building maintenance across Canada today. We attribute our success to staying true to our core values of Service, Motivate, Respect, and Connect. As we continue to grow we are looking to add a Service Coordinator-Supply Chain (ON-SITE) to the Scandi Family!

This is a contract position ending September 30, 2027.

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00am-4:30pm with a 1-hour lunch (30 minutes paid and 30 minutes unpaid)

Located in our head office- this role is an IN-OFFICE position.

Summary of role

The Service Coordinator oversees the scheduling and coordination of maintenance and repair services for floor cleaning equipment. This position ensures that customer service requests are managed promptly, parts and labor are properly assigned, and service records are accurately maintained. The Service Coordinator collaborates closely with technicians and customers to ensure reliable, high-quality service and minimal equipment downtime.

    What your day to day will look like:

    You will be reporting into the Vice President of Procurement.

    • Maintain accurate and detailed reports on all repairs and inspections.
    • Understand warranty claims and work with our vendors to maintain warranty repairs and how to follow up with equipment vendors to have warranty claims completed properly.
    • Assist our asset manager with the tracking of company assets and plan repairs if required.
    • Respond to inquiries from our managers in the field and provide up to date information regarding the status of repair requests, etc.
    • Complete monthly reports and complete other documentation as needed.
    • Operate company forklift.
    • Other duties as needed.

    What you’ll need to succeed:

    • Considerable knowledge of equipment servicing
    • Excellent interpersonal communication skills
    • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external vendors and customers.
    • Be the point of contact for owner operator and internal managers looking to have equipment repaired in a timely manner.
    • Maintain the schedule of our internal repair technicians.
    • Ability to make decisions; evaluate situations quickly and offer solutions.
    • Ability to work under tight deadlines with an elevated level of accuracy and strong diligence.

      Our interview process:

      • 20 minute preliminary phone interview with our Recruiter
      • 20-40 minute assessment (depending on optional practice questions or breaks)
      • There will be 2 rounds of interview for the role
        • Round 1 Interview: Hiring Manager (VP of Procurement) and Supply Chain Manager
        • Round 2 interview: Hiring Manager (VP of Procurement) and CFO


      At Scandinavian Building Services we are an equal opportunity employer who values a diverse workplace. We recognize the strength that comes from different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives and welcome all candidates to apply. We feel it is important that all people have access and opportunity to be employed, to be valued and to be respected.

title: Electrical Construction Engineer (Bilingual- Korean & English)
description:
Company Description

As a global engineering solutions firm that plays a leading role in the areas of plants, architecture and asset management, Hyundai Engineering is expanding into renewable energy to build a sustainable future. In the area of plants, the company provides total solutions for front-end engineering design (FEED) as well as engineering, procurement and construction (EPC).


Job Summary

We are seeking an proactive Electrical Construction Engineer to join our project. The candidate will be responsible for conducting electrical, telecom, fire-alarm (hereinafter “ETF”) inspections, reviewing construction drawings, and monitoring field installation quality in accordance with NEC requirements and project specifications. Coordinates permit inspections and supports resolution of field issues to ensure safe and compliant project execution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage overall construction activities and coordinate project schedules for electrical works
  • Review design drawings and ensure quality control of materials and installation
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, engineering teams, and project stakeholders
  • Conduct quality control inspections for electrical materials, equipment, and installations
  • Support permitting activities and coordinate with regulatory authorities as required
  • Ensure compliance with electrical safety codes, quality standards, and on-site safety rules
  • Monitor progress and assist in resolving construction issues. Maintain project records and perform other related duties as assigned
  • Utilize MS Office, Auto CAD, and project management software


Qualifications

  • Strong bilingual (Korean / English) communication and documentation skills
  • Experience in technical interpretation or international client communication
  • Knowledge of subcontractor procurement and contract administration
  • Excellent coordination and problem-solving, and teamwork skills
  • Experience with construction related documentation, submittals, drawings, reports, etc
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office experience (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) and Auto CAD


Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical, Telecom, Fire Alarm Engineering, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in engineering, construction or similar roles
  • Experience with AHJ inspections, and NEC code compliance is preferred
  • Experience in large-scale construction sites such as buildings, plants, or data centers preferred
  • Experience with electrical quantity take-offs, cost estimation, subcontractor administration, and permitting support


Additional Information

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Weekend work may be required depending on the project schedule


Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Performance of the essential functions typically require sitting, standing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, handling tools or controls, talking, hearing, seeing, repetitive motions, and include the physical ability to navigate active job sites and construction areas Employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.


Work Environment

Work is performed in a variety of environments ranging from the office to construction sites, which may involve working near moving mechanical parts, equipment, or machinery on rough or uneven surfaces, and exposure to dust, noise, chemicals, odors, gas, oils, fumes, extreme temperatures, or heights. May occasionally be exposed to inclement or hazardous conditions, including but not limited to inadequate lighting, work space restrictions, and intense noises and travel; requiring moderate physical activities.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by incumbents. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills required of personnel so classified and it is not a contract express or implied. All employees may have other duties assigned at any time.

title: Empower House: Radio and Communications Intern
description:
Empower House provides transformative community health services, youth development programs, and advocacy opportunities that
empower women and girls of color. We envision a world where all women and girls are empowered to transform themselves, their
families, and their communities. Empower House Radio 101.5 is San Antonio’s pulse for advocacy, change, and community
connection. Our mission is to amplify local content and shine a spotlight on the city’s most diverse stories. Our programming strives
to uplift the powerful perspectives of women of color, voices of LGBTQ+ individuals, and create a space where inspiring, educational
content, elevates community voice.

The Radio Intern will work closely with the Empower House Radio Team to support the creation, editing, and scheduling of content
for 101.5, The Empower House. This role offers hands-on experience in radio production, audio editing, and community storytelling.
The ideal candidate for this position can share their passion for grassroots community transformation and connect their professional
and volunteer experiences to our mission. Our organizational philosophy is based on understanding how sexism, racism, and other
forms of oppression intersect, preventing women, girls, from attaining their full potential. Women, people of color, LGBTQ and nonbinary individuals are strongly encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
Radio Production & Content Creation
• Research and pitch ideas for shows (2–3 stories, interviews, or segments per month)
• Assist with coordinating recording schedules and logistics
• Help identify and organize interviews with potential guests
• Create and organize music playlists for scheduled programming
• Support the development and maintenance of an audio archive for reuse and future programming
• Edit Audio for original recordings and nationally syndicated content with guidance from the radio team

Community Engagement & Collaboration
• Support community members and staff with resources for producing radio content
• Help sustain and build relationships with community partners and contributors
• Assist in planning and leading radio-focused events and workshops
• Provide promotional support for shows and community-created content

Key Skills and Qualifications
• Alignment with Empower House values of Solidarity, Empathy, Collaboration, and Creativity
• Strong teamwork and communication skills (written and verbal)
• Research skills to support content development
• Flexibility and ability to adapt to shifting schedules, especially around interviews and recordings
• Basic audio editing skills preferred (experience with DeScript, Audacity, Adobe Audition, Izotope RX, or similar platforms)
• Ability to attend meetings in person, over the phone, or via Zoom, occasionally for extended sessions
• Enthusiasm for community-based storytelling and media production

title: Cloud Solution Architect - Cloud & AI Applications
location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
description:
Overview

Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of AI & Applications, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) – Cloud & AI Applications for commercial customers at Microsoft. Here, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.

We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect – Cloud & AI Applications to help customers bring their AI-powered applications to production scale on Azure. In this customer-facing role, you’ll lead technical engagements across design, build, and operations, removing blockers and accelerating adoption of Azure AI, App Services, Serverless, Containers, and GitHub. As part of the Cloud + AI Apps team, you will deliver engagements with accountability for customer satisfaction, delivery excellence, Cloud consumption growth, and successful deployment for the customer. You will ensure production readiness of mission-critical workloads like Azure AI Foundry, AKS, App Services, and GitHub with a variety of languages like C#, Python, and .NET, plus collaborate with customer executives, developers, and engineers to turn innovation into real-world outcomes.

By applying to this role, you will be considered for multiple opportunities within Microsoft across the United States including locations beyond where the role is posted. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home. Travel percentages will very according to role.



Responsibilities

Engage with customer IT and business leaders to understand their application and AI priorities, and design secure, scalable solutions that drive business value and customer satisfaction.

  • Lead technical engagements across architecture design, Proof of Concepts (POCs), and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) to accelerate adoption of Azure AI, App Services, Containers, and GitHub.
  • Own the end-to-end technical delivery results, ensuring completeness and accuracy of consumption and customer success plans in collaboration with the Customer Success Account Manager.
  • Drive next best actions and generate incremental Cloud pipeline from each engagement.
  • Deliver repeatable intellectual property (IP) and contribute to centralized IP development to accelerate deployment and achieve targeted outcomes.
  • Provide delivery oversight and escalation support for key Cloud Acceleration Factory engagements across AI and App Innovation projects.
  • Lead the health, resiliency, security, and optimization of mission-critical workloads, ensuring readiness for production-scale AI use cases.
  • Act as the Voice of the Customer by sharing insights and feedback with engineering teams to influence product improvements and remove adoption blockers.
  • Support customer skilling through technical workshops, readiness activities, and recommendations that ensure solution performance, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Maintain deep technical expertise and stay current with Azure, AI, GitHub, and cloud-native development trends, while contributing to internal and external technical communities.

  • Collaborate hands‑on with customer development teams to understand their application landscape and constraints, then design and drive application migration and modernization strategies that improve scalability, resiliency, and readiness for AI‑powered workloads on Azure.
  • Demonstrate a growth mindset by continuously aligning your skills to customer needs, contributing to knowledge sharing, and mentoring others to accelerate customer outcomes.
  • Embody our culture and values


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 2+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
    • OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements:

  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR a Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 6+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years experience working on technical projects.
  • Proficiency in workloads including Azure AI Foundry, AKS, App Service, APIM, and GitHub.
  • Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications).
